Reviewer
ne-1fo01zz lesson prose

1.4 The PN junction, forward bias and reverse bias hw-u1.html

English — what it is meant to say

Definition — learn this wording A PN junction is formed when a P-type and an N-type material are joined in a single crystal. It is the basis of the diode. At the join, free electrons from the N side cross and fill holes on the P side. That leaves a thin strip with no free carriers — the depletion region — and exposed ions that create a barrier potential of about 0.7 V in silicon (0.3 V in germanium). Forward bias: P to the positive terminal, N to the negative. The depletion region narrows, and once the supply exceeds the barrier, current flows. Reverse bias: the connections are swapped. Carriers are pulled away from the join, the depletion region widens, and current stops — apart from a tiny leakage current carried by the minority carriers.

नेपाली — the text under review

परिभाषा — यही शब्दमा सम्झनुहोस् PN junction भनेको एउटै क्रिस्टलमा P-type र N-type पदार्थ जोडिँदा बन्ने जोड हो। Diode यसैमा आधारित छ। जोडमा N तर्फका स्वतन्त्र electron पारि गएर P तर्फका hole भर्छन्। त्यसले स्वतन्त्र वाहक नभएको पातलो पट्टी छोड्छ — depletion region — र खुला ion हरूले silicon मा करिब ०.७ V (germanium मा ०.३ V) को barrier potential बनाउँछन्। Forward bias: P धनात्मक टर्मिनलमा, N ऋणात्मकमा। Depletion region साँघुरो हुन्छ, र सप्लाईले barrier नाघेपछि current बग्छ। Reverse bias: जडान उल्टिन्छ। वाहकहरू जोडबाट टाढा तानिन्छन्, depletion region चौडा हुन्छ, र current रोकिन्छ — अल्पसंख्यक वाहकले बोक्ने अति सानो leakage current बाहेक।

Technical terms left in English: PN junction P-type N-type Diode electron hole depletion region ion silicon germanium barrier potential Forward bias Depletion current Reverse leakage

2.1 The basic units of a computer system hw-u2.html

English — what it is meant to say

Definition — learn this wording Every computer, from a phone to a server, is built from the same five functional units: input, control, arithmetic and logic, memory and output. The middle three together are the CPU (Central Processing Unit). That grouping is what a question means when it says "the components of the CPU". The order matters and it is always the same: data comes in, is held in memory, is worked on by the ALU under the direction of the control unit, and the result goes out.

नेपाली — the text under review

परिभाषा — यही शब्दमा सम्झनुहोस् फोनदेखि सर्भरसम्म हरेक कम्प्युटर उही पाँच कार्यात्मक एकाइबाट बनेको हुन्छ: input, control, arithmetic and logic, memory र output। बीचका तीन मिलेर CPU (Central Processing Unit) बन्छ। "CPU का भागहरू" भनेर सोधिँदा यही समूह खोजिएको हुन्छ। क्रम महत्त्वपूर्ण छ र सधैं उही हुन्छ: data भित्र आउँछ, मेमोरीमा राखिन्छ, control unit को निर्देशनमा ALU ले काम गर्छ, र नतिजा बाहिर जान्छ।

Technical terms left in English: input control arithmetic and logic memory output CPU Central Processing Unit data unit ALU

ne-1gz3s0 lesson prose

2.2 The input unit hw-u2.html

English — what it is meant to say

Definition — learn this wording The input unit accepts data and instructions from the outside world and converts them into the binary form the computer can process. Keyboard — each key press closes a switch; the keyboard controller turns that into a scan code, which becomes a character. Mouse — a pointing device. An optical mouse photographs the surface many times a second and works out which way it moved. Scanner — shines light across a document and measures the reflection, producing an image of the page. OCR software is what turns that image into editable text. Digital camera — a lens focuses light onto an image sensor, which converts the brightness at each point into a number and stores it in memory.

नेपाली — the text under review

परिभाषा — यही शब्दमा सम्झनुहोस् Input unit ले बाहिरी संसारबाट data र निर्देशन लिन्छ र कम्प्युटरले प्रशोधन गर्न सक्ने binary रूपमा बदल्छ। Keyboard — हरेक किथिचाइले एउटा स्विच बन्द गर्छ; keyboard controller ले त्यसलाई scan code बनाउँछ, जुन अक्षर बन्छ। Mouse — देखाउने उपकरण। Optical mouse ले सेकेन्डमा धेरै पटक सतहको फोटो खिच्छ र कता सर्‍यो पत्ता लगाउँछ। Scanner — कागजमा बत्ती पार गरेर परावर्तन नाप्छ, र पानाको चित्र बनाउँछ। त्यो चित्रलाई सम्पादन गर्न मिल्ने अक्षरमा बदल्ने काम OCR सफ्टवेयरको हो। Digital camera — लेन्सले बत्ती image sensor मा केन्द्रित गर्छ, जसले हरेक बिन्दुको उज्यालोलाई सङ्ख्यामा बदलेर मेमोरीमा राख्छ।

2.3 The processing unit — ALU and control unit hw-u2.html

English — what it is meant to say

Definition — learn this wording The ALU (Arithmetic and Logic Unit) performs all arithmetic operations (+ − × ÷) and all logical operations (greater than, less than, equal to, AND, OR, NOT). Every calculation and every comparison in the machine happens here and nowhere else. The control unit (CU) directs the whole system. It fetches each instruction from memory, decodes it to work out what is required, and sends the signals that tell each unit what to do and when. It does not calculate anything itself. A useful picture: the ALU is the worker, the control unit is the supervisor. The supervisor decides what gets done next; the worker does it.

नेपाली — the text under review

परिभाषा — यही शब्दमा सम्झनुहोस् ALU (Arithmetic and Logic Unit) ले सबै अंकगणितीय काम (+ − × ÷) र सबै तार्किक काम (ठूलो, सानो, बराबर, AND, OR, NOT) गर्छ। मेसिनको हरेक गणना र हरेक तुलना यहीँ हुन्छ, अन्त कतै हुँदैन। Control unit (CU) ले पूरै प्रणाली निर्देशित गर्छ। मेमोरीबाट हरेक निर्देशन ल्याउँछ, के चाहिएको हो बुझ्छ, र कुन एकाइले कहिले के गर्ने भन्ने सङ्केत पठाउँछ। यसले आफैँ केही गणना गर्दैन। सम्झने तरिका: ALU कामदार हो, control unit सुपरभाइजर। सुपरभाइजरले अब के गर्ने भन्छ; कामदारले गर्छ।

Technical terms left in English: ALU Arithmetic and Logic Unit AND OR NOT Control unit CU control

ne-bnh91u lesson prose

2.4 The display unit hw-u2.html

English — what it is meant to say

Definition — learn this wording Resolution is the number of pixels across by the number down — 1366 × 768. More pixels means a sharper picture and more detail in the same area. Colour depth is the number of bits used to describe one pixel's colour. 24-bit gives about 16.7 million colours; fewer bits produce visible banding in a gradient. Refresh rate is how many times per second the screen is redrawn, measured in hertz. 60 Hz means sixty times a second. Too low a rate is visible as flicker and causes eye strain. CRT fires an electron beam at a phosphor coating — bulky, heavy, hot, most power. LCD uses liquid crystals to block or pass light from a lamp behind them — flat and far cooler. LED is an LCD whose backlight is made of LEDs instead — thinner still, better contrast, least power.

नेपाली — the text under review

English — what it is meant to say

The BIOS is firmware on a motherboard chip. It has to run before any disk is read — it is what finds and loads the operating system — so it cannot be stored on the disk. RAM is wrong because RAM is empty at power-on.

CMOS memory holds the BIOS settings and runs the clock, and it needs power even when the machine is unplugged. That power comes from a coin battery on the board. When it dies, everything CMOS remembers is lost each time mains power goes — which is exactly this symptom.

A sector is one slice of a track and is the smallest addressable unit. A track is a whole concentric ring, a cylinder is the same track across all platters, and a platter is the entire disk — all three are larger than a sector.

English — what it is meant to say

Seek time is the arm moving to the correct track, rotational delay is waiting for the sector to come round under the head, and transfer time is reading or writing the data. The first two are mechanical, which is why they dominate and why a solid-state drive is so much faster.

Seek time भनेको arm ठीक track मा जाने, rotational delay भनेको sector head मुनि आइपुग्न पर्खने, र transfer time भनेको data पढ्ने वा लेख्ने। पहिलो दुई यान्त्रिक हुन् — त्यसैले तिनकै बढी समय लाग्छ, र solid-state drive यति छिटो हुनुको कारण पनि त्यही हो।

A quick format rewrites the file system index only, so the drive reports itself as empty while the sectors still hold the data. Recovery software scans sectors directly instead of trusting the index. To remove data properly you need a full format or a wipe utility that overwrites every sector.

3.1 The system BIOS hw-u3.html

English — what it is meant to say

Definition — learn this wording BIOS (Basic Input Output System) is firmware stored on a chip on the motherboard. It is the first program that runs when the machine is switched on — before any operating system exists in memory. Its four functions: 1. POST (Power-On Self Test) — checks that the essential hardware is present and working. If something fails, it reports with beep codes, because the screen may not be available yet. 2. Bootstrap loader — finds the operating system on a drive and loads it into memory. 3. BIOS drivers — low-level control of the basic hardware so the machine can work before the OS drivers load. 4. CMOS setup — the screen where boot order, time and hardware settings are changed. Those settings are kept in CMOS memory, powered by a small battery.

नेपाली — the text under review

परिभाषा — यही शब्दमा सम्झनुहोस् BIOS (Basic Input Output System) मदरबोर्डको चिपमा राखिएको firmware हो। मेसिन खोल्दा सबैभन्दा पहिले चल्ने प्रोग्राम यही हो — मेमोरीमा कुनै अपरेटिङ सिस्टम आउनुअघि नै। यसका चार काम: १. POST (Power-On Self Test) — आवश्यक हार्डवेयर छ र चलिरहेको छ कि जाँच्छ। केही बिग्रिए बीप कोड ले सुनाउँछ, किनकि स्क्रिन अझै उपलब्ध नहुन सक्छ। २. Bootstrap loader — ड्राइभमा अपरेटिङ सिस्टम खोजेर मेमोरीमा लोड गर्छ। ३. BIOS drivers — आधारभूत हार्डवेयरको तल्लो तहको नियन्त्रण, ताकि OS का driver लोड हुनुअघि पनि मेसिन चल्न सकोस्। ४. CMOS setup — boot order, समय र हार्डवेयर सेटिङ बदल्ने स्क्रिन। ती सेटिङ CMOS मेमोरीमा रहन्छन्, जसलाई सानो ब्याट्रीले चलाउँछ।

3.2 The motherboard and its form factors hw-u3.html

English — what it is meant to say

Definition — learn this wording The motherboard is the main printed circuit board. Every other component either plugs into it or connects to it, and it carries the buses that let them communicate. A form factor is the standard that fixes a board's size, its mounting-hole positions, and where its ports and power connector sit. ATX is the common desktop standard; Micro-ATX and Mini-ITX are smaller versions with fewer slots. The form factor is why a replacement board is not simply "any board" — it must match the case it has to screw into and the power supply that has to feed it.

नेपाली — the text under review

3.3 The PCI local bus hw-u3.html

English — what it is meant to say

Definition — learn this wording A bus is a set of parallel wires that carries data, addresses and control signals between components. PCI (Peripheral Component Interconnect) is a local bus — "local" meaning it runs close to the processor and at high speed, rather than out on a slow peripheral path. Its expansion slots take add-on cards: graphics, sound, network, additional ports. This is what makes a desktop upgradable — a capability the board does not have can be added as a card instead of replacing the whole machine. PCI cards are also plug and play: the system detects the card and allocates the resources it needs, instead of the user setting jumpers by hand.

नेपाली — the text under review

परिभाषा — यही शब्दमा सम्झनुहोस् Bus भनेको भागहरूबीच data, ठेगाना र नियन्त्रण सङ्केत बोक्ने समानान्तर तारहरूको समूह हो। PCI (Peripheral Component Interconnect) एउटा local bus हो — "local" भनेको यो ढिलो peripheral बाटोमा नभई प्रोसेसरको नजिक, उच्च गतिमा चल्छ। यसका expansion slot ले थप कार्ड लिन्छन्: graphics, sound, network, थप पोर्ट। डेस्कटप अपग्रेड गर्न मिल्ने यसैले हुन्छ — बोर्डमा नभएको क्षमता पूरै मेसिन साट्नुको साटो कार्ड थपेर ल्याउन सकिन्छ। PCI कार्ड plug and play पनि हुन्छन्: प्रयोगकर्ताले हातले jumper मिलाउनुपर्दैन, प्रणालीले कार्ड पत्ता लगाएर चाहिने साधन बाँडिदिन्छ।

3.4 The internal power supply hw-u3.html

English — what it is meant to say

Definition — learn this wording The SMPS (Switched Mode Power Supply) converts the AC mains supply into the low DC voltages the components need, and it must do so cleanly and steadily. Its main parts: a transformer to change the voltage, a rectifier to convert AC into DC, a filter to smooth what is left of the ripple, a voltage regulator to hold each output steady as the load changes, and a cooling fan. The outputs: +12 V for motors and the processor circuits, +5 V and +3.3 V for the board's logic and the drives. A supply that is failing does not always die outright. It often produces voltages that are out of range under load, which shows up as random restarts and faults that move around — the hardest kind to diagnose.

नेपाली — the text under review

परिभाषा — यही शब्दमा सम्झनुहोस् SMPS (Switched Mode Power Supply) ले मुख्य AC बिजुलीलाई भागहरूलाई चाहिने कम DC भोल्टेजमा बदल्छ, र त्यो सफा तथा स्थिर हुनुपर्छ। यसका मुख्य भाग: भोल्टेज बदल्न transformer, AC लाई DC बनाउन rectifier, बाँकी ripple मिलाउन filter, भार बदलिँदा पनि हरेक आउटपुट स्थिर राख्न voltage regulator, र कुलिङ पंखा। आउटपुट: मोटर र प्रोसेसर परिपथका लागि +१२ V, बोर्डको लजिक र ड्राइभका लागि +५ V र +३.३ V। बिग्रँदै गएको सप्लाई सधैं एकैचोटि मर्दैन। भार पर्दा दायराबाहिरको भोल्टेज दिन्छ, जुन अनियमित रिस्टार्ट र ठाउँ बदलिरहने खराबीका रूपमा देखिन्छ — निदान गर्न सबैभन्दा गाह्रो किसिम।

Technical terms left in English: SMPS Switched Mode Power Supply AC DC transformer rectifier ripple filter voltage regulator

3.5 Hard disk construction and operation hw-u3.html

English — what it is meant to say

Definition — learn this wording A hard disk drive stores data magnetically on rigid rotating platters. Track — one concentric ring on a platter surface. Sector — one slice of a track, and the smallest unit that can be read or written. Cylinder — the same track number on every platter, taken together. Read-write head — mounted on an actuator arm, floating microns above the surface on a cushion of air. Access time is made of three parts added together: seek time (the arm moves to the right track), rotational delay (the disk turns until the sector arrives), and transfer time (the data is read). The head never touches the platter. When it does — from a knock while running — that is a head crash, and the damage is physical.

नेपाली — the text under review

परिभाषा — यही शब्दमा सम्झनुहोस् Hard disk drive ले घुम्ने कडा platter मा चुम्बकीय रूपमा data राख्छ। Track — platter सतहको एउटा केन्द्रित रिङ। Sector — track को एउटा टुक्रा, र पढ्न–लेख्न मिल्ने सबैभन्दा सानो एकाइ। Cylinder — हरेक platter को उही नम्बरको track सँगै लिँदा। Read-write head — actuator arm मा जडित, हावाको तकियामा सतहभन्दा माइक्रोन मात्र माथि तैरिने। Access time तीन भागको योग हो: seek time (arm ठीक track मा जाने), rotational delay (sector आइपुग्न डिस्क घुम्ने), र transfer time (data पढिने)। Head ले platter छुँदैन। चलिरहेको बेला धक्का लागेर छोयो भने त्यो head crash हो, र क्षति भौतिक हुन्छ।

Technical terms left in English: Hard disk drive platter data Track Sector track Cylinder Read-write head actuator arm Access time seek rotational delay sector transfer Head crash

3.6 Partitioning and formatting hw-u3.html

English — what it is meant to say

Definition — learn this wording Partitioning divides one physical disk into separate areas that the operating system treats as independent drives. A primary partition can be booted from. An extended partition is a container that holds logical drives; the extended partition itself gets no drive letter. Drive lettering assigns C:, D:, E: and so on. Reasons to partition: separating the operating system from data so the OS can be reinstalled without losing files, running more than one OS, and keeping backups organised. Formatting writes a file system onto a partition so files can be stored. Quick format clears the index only — the data is still physically there until it is overwritten. Full format also scans every sector for defects, which is why it takes far longer.

नेपाली — the text under review

परिभाषा — यही शब्दमा सम्झनुहोस् Partitioning ले एउटै भौतिक डिस्कलाई छुट्टाछुट्टै क्षेत्रमा बाँड्छ, जसलाई अपरेटिङ सिस्टमले स्वतन्त्र ड्राइभ मान्छ। Primary partition बाट boot गर्न सकिन्छ। Extended partition भनेको logical drive राख्ने भाँडो हो; extended partition आफैँले ड्राइभ अक्षर पाउँदैन। Drive lettering ले C:, D:, E: आदि दिन्छ। Partition गर्ने कारण: अपरेटिङ सिस्टमलाई data बाट छुट्याउनु ताकि फाइल नगुमाई OS फेरि इन्स्टल गर्न सकियोस्, एकभन्दा बढी OS चलाउनु, र ब्याकअप व्यवस्थित राख्नु। Formatting ले partition मा file system लेख्छ ताकि फाइल राख्न सकियोस्। Quick format ले सूची मात्र मेटाउँछ — data नओभरराइट भएसम्म भौतिक रूपमा त्यहीँ हुन्छ। Full format ले हरेक sector मा खराबी पनि जाँच्छ, त्यसैले धेरै समय लाग्छ।

English — what it is meant to say

Beeping IS the POST reporting, so power reached the board and the BIOS started — the power path is already ruled out. It is beeping rather than displaying because the fault was found before video was initialised, which makes memory the first suspect. The OS and the disk are not read until much later.

boot questions/grade10-hardware.js

English — what it is meant to say

A readable message on screen proves video works, and the BIOS only reaches the point of looking for an operating system after POST has passed — so power, memory and video are all fine. What has NOT been proved is the disk: the message says the OS was not found, which is exactly what is still in question.

English — what it is meant to say

The timing is the evidence. A fault present from the start would be slow immediately — too many startup programs is slow from boot. Something that only appears after the machine has warmed up, and appears sooner under load because load makes more heat, is thermal. The processor deliberately reduces its speed to protect itself.

नेपाली — the text under review

Beeping is the POST reporting. It only happens once power has reached the board and the BIOS is running — so the power supply, the switch and the mains are all already ruled out. Reviewer
ne-108if42 gloss

Exam focus — what is asked from this unit hw-u4.html

English — what it is meant to say

Work from the cheapest check outward. First confirm the monitor has power and the video cable is firm at both ends, and try a monitor known to work — this rules out the display path. Then listen at power-on: repeated beeps mean POST found a fault before video was available, which points to memory. Power off, unplug, and reseat the RAM modules one at a time until the clips close. If the beeps continue with a module known to be good, the slot or the board is at fault. Change only one thing at a time, and verify the display returns before closing the case.

ne-1a5byyp lesson prose

4.1 General troubleshooting techniques hw-u4.html

English — what it is meant to say

The principles a technician works by Check the simplest and cheapest thing first. A loose cable costs five seconds to rule out; an opened case costs twenty minutes and a risk of damage. Change one thing at a time. Change two and the fault goes away, you no longer know which change fixed it — and you cannot prevent it happening again. Work from the symptom, not from a hunch. The symptom already tells you how far the machine got before it stopped, which rules out everything that happens later. Do not replace parts to diagnose. Substituting a known-good part is a legitimate test; buying a new one because you suspect it is not. Observe safety. Power off and unplug before opening a case. Never work inside a power supply or a CRT monitor — both store dangerous charge after being unplugged.

4.2 The steps of troubleshooting hw-u4.html

English — what it is meant to say

What each step produces 1. Identify the problem — a precise statement of what happens and when. "It does not work" is not one; "it powers on, fans spin, screen stays black" is. 2. Gather information — ask the user what changed. New hardware, a storm, a move, a spill, an update. Most faults have a cause the user can tell you about. 3. Establish a theory of probable cause — the most likely cause consistent with the symptom, not every possible cause. 4. Test the theory — one check, one change. If the test disproves the theory, go back to step 3 and form a new one. Do not start swapping parts. 5. Apply the fix and verify — confirm the original symptom is actually gone, and that nothing else broke while you were working. 6. Document — what the symptom was, what caused it, what fixed it. This is what makes the second occurrence quick.

नेपाली — the text under review

हरेक चरणले के दिन्छ १. समस्या पहिचान — के हुन्छ र कहिले हुन्छ भन्ने ठ्याक्कै कथन। "चल्दैन" कथन होइन; "बिजुली आउँछ, पंखा घुम्छ, स्क्रिन कालै रहन्छ" कथन हो। २. जानकारी सङ्कलन — प्रयोगकर्तालाई के बदलियो सोध्नुहोस्। नयाँ हार्डवेयर, चट्याङ, सारेको, पानी खसेको, अपडेट। धेरैजसो खराबीको कारण प्रयोगकर्ताले नै बताउन सक्छ। ३. सम्भावित कारणको अनुमान बनाउनुहोस् — लक्षणसँग मिल्ने सबैभन्दा सम्भावित कारण, हरेक सम्भावित कारण होइन। ४. अनुमान परीक्षण — एउटा जाँच, एउटा परिवर्तन। परीक्षणले अनुमान गलत साबित गरे चरण ३ मा फर्किनुहोस् र नयाँ बनाउनुहोस्। पार्ट साट्न नथाल्नुहोस्। ५. समाधान लागू गरी पुष्टि — सुरुको लक्षण साँच्चै हट्यो कि, र काम गर्दा अरू केही बिग्रियो कि जाँच्नुहोस्। ६. अभिलेख — लक्षण के थियो, कारण के थियो, केले मिलायो। दोस्रो पटक छिटो हुनुको कारण यही हो।

4.3 Troubleshooting boot problems hw-u4.html

English — what it is meant to say

Read how far it got A boot problem is diagnosed by asking how far the machine reached before it stopped. Each stage rules out everything after it. Nothing at all — no lights, no fans. Power is not arriving: mains, cable, switch, power supply. Fans spin, screen black, beeps — power is fine and POST is running. The BIOS found a fault before video was available; memory is the usual cause. Manufacturer logo, then an error message — POST passed. The hardware is working and the problem is with finding or loading the operating system. OS starts, then fails — hardware and boot sector are fine. The fault is in the operating system, a driver, or software.

नेपाली — the text under review

कहाँसम्म पुग्यो पढ्नुहोस् Boot समस्याको निदान मेसिन रोकिनुअघि कहाँसम्म पुग्यो भनेर गरिन्छ। हरेक चरणले त्यसपछिका सबै सम्भावना हटाउँछ। केही पनि छैन — बत्ती छैन, पंखा छैन। बिजुली नै आइरहेको छैन: मुख्य लाइन, केबल, स्विच, पावर सप्लाई। पंखा घुम्छ, स्क्रिन कालो, बीप — बिजुली ठीक छ र POST चलिरहेको छ। Video उपलब्ध हुनुअघि नै BIOS ले खराबी भेट्यो; प्रायः मेमोरी कारण हुन्छ। कम्पनीको लोगो, अनि त्रुटि सन्देश — POST पास भयो। हार्डवेयर चलिरहेको छ र समस्या अपरेटिङ सिस्टम भेट्न वा लोड गर्नमा छ। OS सुरु हुन्छ, अनि बिग्रिन्छ — हार्डवेयर र boot sector ठीक छन्। खराबी अपरेटिङ सिस्टम, driver वा सफ्टवेयरमा छ।

ne-iu8nkh lesson prose

4.5 Troubleshooting system slowdowns hw-u4.html

English — what it is meant to say

The usual causes, and how to tell them apart Too little RAM — the machine slows badly when several programs are open, and the disk light stays on as it swaps memory to disk. Closing programs helps immediately. Too many startup programs — slow from the moment it boots, and slow at everything rather than at one task. A nearly full or fragmented disk — everything involving files is slow. There is no room left for temporary files and virtual memory. Malware — slow with no obvious cause, often with network activity when nothing is open, and often appearing suddenly rather than gradually. Overheating — fast at first, then slow after a while, because the processor deliberately reduces its speed to protect itself. The timing is the clue.

power-protection questions/grade10-hardware.js

English — what it is meant to say

The power disappears entirely. A surge protector handles voltage that is too high and a stabiliser handles voltage that is too low — neither can supply power that is not there. Only a UPS carries a battery, and its purpose is to give enough time to save work and shut down properly.

cooling questions/grade10-hardware.js

English — what it is meant to say

The shutdown is the protection working correctly — it is stopping the processor being damaged. The fault is whatever prevents the heat escaping: dust in the heatsink fins, a stopped or slowed fan, dried thermal paste, or blocked vents. The processor is producing its normal amount of heat.

virus questions/grade10-hardware.js

English — what it is meant to say

An antivirus recognises threats by comparing against what it knows. New malware appears constantly, so a scanner that is never updated is blind to everything released after installation. This is why "install antivirus" alone is a half answer — "and keep it updated" is the other half of the mark.

English — what it is meant to say

A flat panel has one native resolution and is sharp only at that setting; anything else is scaled to fit and goes soft, and a wrong aspect ratio also stretches the picture. Low refresh rate causes flicker, not blur. 24-bit colour depth is normal, not a fault.

Exam focus — what is asked from this unit hw-u5.html

English — what it is meant to say

This unit is the widest in the subject — eleven topics for 9 marks — so questions are short and drawn from anywhere in it. The reliable ones are: list preventive maintenance tasks (pair each with the failure it prevents and you answer a 4-mark question with a 3-mark list), differentiate UPS, surge protector and voltage stabiliser, what is a computer virus and how do you prevent infection, and why must a processor be cooled. Expect at least one symptom-to-cause question drawn from the display and connection faults.

5.1 Preventive maintenance hw-u5.html

English — what it is meant to say

Definition — learn this wording Preventive maintenance is work done on a system that is still working, to stop failures before they happen and to extend the equipment's life. Each task exists because of a specific failure it prevents — that pairing is what the exam wants, not the list on its own: Cleaning dust from vents, fans and heatsinks — prevents overheating and the sudden shutdowns it causes. Checking that all cables and cards are firmly seated — prevents intermittent faults that are very hard to trace. Deleting temporary files and defragmenting the disk — prevents slowdowns and the disk filling up. Updating the operating system and antivirus — closes the security holes malware uses to get in. Taking regular backups — the only preventive measure that works after the hardware has already failed. Using a UPS and keeping the machine in a cool, dry, ventilated place — prevents damage from power problems, heat and humidity.

नेपाली — the text under review

5.2 Power source and power protection hw-u5.html

English — what it is meant to say

Definition — learn this wording Four things can go wrong with mains power, and a different device protects against each: Surge / spike — a brief, very large rise in voltage, often from lightning or heavy machinery switching off. Protected by a surge protector, which diverts the excess. Sag / brownout — voltage that drops below normal but does not disappear. It can make a system unstable and restart without warning. Protected by a voltage stabiliser. Blackout — power fails completely. Only a UPS (Uninterruptible Power Supply) helps, because it holds a battery that carries the machine long enough to save work and shut down properly. Noise — small unwanted variations riding on the supply. Filtered by a UPS or a conditioner. A UPS is not a generator. It buys minutes, not hours, and its purpose is a clean shutdown.

नेपाली — the text under review

परिभाषा — यही शब्दमा सम्झनुहोस् मुख्य बिजुलीमा चार किसिमका समस्या आउँछन्, र हरेकबाट फरक उपकरणले जोगाउँछ: Surge / spike — छोटो तर धेरै ठूलो भोल्टेज बढाइ, प्रायः चट्याङ वा ठूलो मेसिन बन्द हुँदा। Surge protector ले जोगाउँछ, जसले बढी बिजुली अन्तै पठाउँछ। Sag / brownout — भोल्टेज सामान्यभन्दा तल झर्नु, तर पूरै नजानु। प्रणाली अस्थिर बनाउँछ र चेतावनीबिनै रिस्टार्ट गराउँछ। Voltage stabiliser ले जोगाउँछ। Blackout — बिजुली पूरै जानु। UPS (Uninterruptible Power Supply) ले मात्र काम गर्छ, किनकि यसमा ब्याट्री हुन्छ जसले काम बचाएर ठीकसँग बन्द गर्न पुग्ने बेर मेसिन चलाइराख्छ। Noise — सप्लाईमै मिसिएर आउने साना अवाञ्छित उतारचढाव। UPS वा conditioner ले छान्छ। UPS जेनेरेटर होइन। यसले घण्टा होइन, मिनेट दिन्छ, र यसको उद्देश्य सफासँग बन्द गर्नु हो।

5.3 Cooling, ventilation and processor power hw-u5.html

English — what it is meant to say

Definition — learn this wording A processor turns electrical power into work and heat. If the heat is not carried away as fast as it is produced, the temperature climbs until the board shuts the machine down to protect the chip. How a processor is cooled: a heatsink of metal fins sits on the chip, with a thin layer of thermal paste filling the microscopic gaps so heat crosses into it. A fan moves air through the fins. The case provides the path: cool air in at the front, warm air out at the back. Processor power and voltage: the board supplies the processor through its own regulator at a low, precisely held voltage. Too low and the system is unstable; too high and the chip is damaged. This is why overclocking without care destroys processors. Thermal shutdown is protection, not a fault. A machine that turns itself off when hot is working correctly — the fault is whatever is stopping the heat leaving.

नेपाली — the text under review

परिभाषा — यही शब्दमा सम्झनुहोस् प्रोसेसरले विद्युतीय शक्तिलाई काम र ताप मा बदल्छ। उत्पादन भएको गतिमै ताप बाहिर नगए तापक्रम बढ्दै जान्छ र चिप जोगाउन बोर्डले मेसिन बन्द गरिदिन्छ। प्रोसेसर कसरी चिसो पारिन्छ: चिपमाथि धातुका पत्र भएको heatsink राखिन्छ, र सूक्ष्म खाली ठाउँ भर्न पातलो thermal paste लगाइन्छ ताकि ताप त्यसमा सरोस्। पंखा ले पत्रबीच हावा चलाउँछ। केस ले बाटो दिन्छ: अगाडिबाट चिसो हावा भित्र, पछाडिबाट न्यानो हावा बाहिर। प्रोसेसरको बिजुली र भोल्टेज: बोर्डले आफ्नै regulator मार्फत प्रोसेसरलाई कम र ठ्याक्कै स्थिर भोल्टेज दिन्छ। कम भए प्रणाली अस्थिर हुन्छ; बढी भए चिप बिग्रिन्छ। ध्यान नपुर्‍याई overclock गर्दा प्रोसेसर नष्ट हुनुको कारण यही हो। तापका कारण बन्द हुनु सुरक्षा हो, खराबी होइन। तातेपछि आफैँ बन्द हुने मेसिन ठीकसँग चलिरहेको छ — ताप बाहिर जान नदिने जुनसुकै कुरा नै खराबी हो।

5.5 Wireless connection problems hw-u5.html

English — what it is meant to say

In this order 1. Is the adapter switched on? Many laptops have a physical switch or a keyboard shortcut, and flight mode disables it entirely. This is the commonest cause and the fastest to check. 2. Is the network visible? If no networks appear at all, the fault is the adapter or its driver. If other networks appear but yours does not, the fault is at the router. 3. Does it connect but not reach the internet? Then the wireless link is fine and the problem is beyond the router — the connection to the provider. 4. Is the signal weak? Distance, thick walls and interference from other equipment all reduce it. Moving closer is a diagnostic step, not just a workaround. 5. Is it the password or the security setting? A wrong key gives a connection that keeps dropping and reconnecting rather than a clean failure.

यही क्रममा १. Adapter खुला छ? धेरै ल्यापटपमा भौतिक स्विच वा किबोर्ड सर्टकट हुन्छ, र flight mode ले पूरै बन्द गर्छ। सबैभन्दा सामान्य कारण र सबैभन्दा छिटो जाँच यही हो। २. नेटवर्क देखिन्छ? कुनै पनि नेटवर्क नदेखिए खराबी adapter वा यसको driver मा छ। अरू देखिने तर आफ्नो नदेखिने भए खराबी router मा छ। ३. जोडिन्छ तर इन्टरनेट आउँदैन? त्यसो भए वायरलेस जडान ठीक छ र समस्या router भन्दा पर — सेवा प्रदायकसँगको जडानमा छ। ४. सिग्नल कमजोर छ? दूरी, बाक्लो भित्ता र अरू उपकरणको हस्तक्षेपले घटाउँछ। नजिक सर्नु समाधान मात्र होइन, निदानको एउटा चरण पनि हो। ५. पासवर्ड वा security सेटिङ हो? गलत key ले सफासँग असफल हुनुको साटो बारम्बार जोडिने र छुट्ने जडान दिन्छ।

5.6 Viruses — detection, protection and prevention hw-u5.html

English — what it is meant to say

Definition — learn this wording A computer virus is a malicious program that attaches itself to another program or file, and copies itself to other files or computers when that host is run. How infection spreads: infected USB drives and external media; email attachments; downloads from untrusted sites; pirated software; and network shares. Signs of infection: the computer slows down for no clear reason; files disappear, change size or will not open; programs start or crash on their own; unexpected messages appear; free disk space falls quickly; the antivirus has been disabled. Detection and protection: install antivirus software and keep it updated — an out-of-date scanner cannot recognise a new virus. Scan removable media before opening it. Enable a firewall. Keep the operating system patched. Prevention: do not open attachments from unknown senders, do not install pirated software, disable autorun on removable media, and take regular backups — the last defence when everything else has failed.

(page furniture) hw-u5.html

English — what it is meant to say

· पहिले अनुमान गर्नुहोस् A school has frequent power cuts and loses unsaved work every time. Which device solves the problem? एउटा विद्यालयमा बारम्बार बिजुली जान्छ र हरेक पटक नबचाइएको काम हराउँछ। कुन उपकरणले यो समस्या समाधान गर्छ? A surge protector A voltage stabiliser A UPS Read what the problem actually is: the power disappears. A surge protector handles voltage that is too high and a stabiliser handles voltage that is too low — neither can supply power that is not there. Only a UPS carries its own battery, and that is why it is the only one of the three that helps in a blackout. समस्या के हो पढ्नुहोस्: बिजुली हराउँछ। Surge protector ले धेरै बढी भोल्टेज सम्हाल्छ र stabiliser ले धेरै कम — नभएको बिजुली दुवैले दिन सक्दैनन्। UPS सँग मात्र आफ्नै ब्याट्री हुन्छ, र तीनमध्ये blackout मा काम लाग्ने एक मात्र यही हुनुको कारण त्यही हो। 5.3 Cooling, ventilation and processor power Definition — learn this wording A processor turns electrical power into work and heat. If the heat is not carried away as fast as it is produced, the temperature climbs until the board shuts the machine down to protect the chip. How a processor is cooled: a heatsink of metal fins sits on the chip, with a thin layer of thermal paste filling the microscopic gaps so heat crosses into it. A fan moves air through the fins. The case provides the path: cool air in at the front, warm air out at the back. Processor power and voltage: the board supplies the processor through its own regulator at a low, precisely held voltage. Too low and the system is unstable; too high and the chip is damaged. This is why overclocking without care destroys processors. Thermal shutdown is protection, not a fault. A machine that turns itself off when hot is working correctly — the fault is whatever is stopping the heat leaving. परिभाषा — यही शब्दमा सम्झनुहोस् प्रोसेसरले विद्युतीय शक्तिलाई काम र ताप मा बदल्छ। उत्पादन भएको गतिमै ताप बाहिर नगए तापक्रम बढ्दै जान्छ र चिप जोगाउन बोर्डले मेसिन बन्द गरिदिन्छ। प्रोसेसर कसरी चिसो पारिन्छ: चिपमाथि धातुका पत्र भएको heatsink राखिन्छ, र सूक्ष्म खाली ठाउँ भर्न पातलो thermal paste लगाइन्छ ताकि ताप त्यसमा सरोस्। पंखा ले पत्रबीच हावा चलाउँछ। केस ले बाटो दिन्छ: अगाडिबाट चिसो हावा भित्र, पछाडिबाट न्यानो हावा बाहिर। प्रोसेसरको बिजुली र भोल्टेज: बोर्डले आफ्नै regulator मार्फत प्रोसेसरलाई कम र ठ्याक्कै स्थिर भोल्टेज दिन्छ। कम भए प्रणाली अस्थिर हुन्छ; बढी भए चिप बिग्रिन्छ। ध्यान नपुर्‍याई overclock गर्दा प्रोसेसर नष्ट हुनुको कारण यही हो। तापका कारण बन्द हुनु सुरक्षा हो, खराबी होइन। तातेपछि आफैँ बन्द हुने मेसिन ठीकसँग चलिरहेको छ — ताप बाहिर जान नदिने जुनसुकै कुरा नै खराबी हो। {{dia:hwCooling}} One path, front to back. Dust on the fins is an insulator: the processor makes its normal heat and simply cannot get rid of it. एउटै बाटो, अगाडिबाट पछाडि। पत्रमा जमेको धुलो इन्सुलेटर हो: प्रोसेसरले सामान्य ताप निकाल्छ तर त्यो बाहिर पठाउनै सक्दैन। Diagnose it yourself

English — what it is meant to say

Each incremental holds only what changed since the previous backup, so the chain must be replayed in order: Monday's full set, then Tuesday, Wednesday, Thursday and Friday. That is five. Option 2 would be right for a DIFFERENTIAL scheme — which is exactly the trade differential buys with its larger daily sets.

ne-dp9ap1 gloss

Exam focus — what is asked from this unit hw-u6.html

English — what it is meant to say

A full backup copies all the data every time; it takes the longest and uses the most media but a restore needs only that one set. An incremental backup copies only what has changed since the last backup of any type; it is the quickest to take and the smallest, but restoring requires the last full backup together with every incremental taken since, and a missing one breaks the chain. A differential backup copies everything changed since the last full backup; each one grows larger than the last, but a restore needs exactly two sets — the full backup and the most recent differential.

Reviewer
ne-1jeus6u gloss

Exam focus — what is asked from this unit hw-u6.html

English — what it is meant to say

RAID (Redundant Array of Independent Disks) combines several physical disks so that the operating system treats them as a single drive, to gain speed, fault tolerance or both. RAID 0 uses striping: data is divided across the disks giving faster access and full capacity, but there is no redundancy and one disk failing loses everything — minimum two disks. RAID 1 uses mirroring: identical data is written to both disks so one can fail without loss, but only half the capacity is usable — minimum two disks. RAID 5 uses striping with parity spread across all disks, so any one disk can fail and be rebuilt from the parity, at the cost of one disk's capacity — minimum three disks.

नेपाली — the text under review

RAID (Redundant Array of Independent Disks) ले धेरै भौतिक डिस्क जोडेर अपरेटिङ सिस्टमलाई एउटै ड्राइभजस्तो देखाउँछ — गति, खराबी सहनशीलता वा दुवैका लागि। RAID 0 ले striping प्रयोग गर्छ: data डिस्कहरूमा बाँडिन्छ, पहुँच छिटो हुन्छ र पूरै क्षमता पाइन्छ, तर redundancy नभएकाले एउटा डिस्क बिग्रिए सबै जान्छ — न्यूनतम दुई डिस्क। RAID 1 ले mirroring प्रयोग गर्छ: दुवै डिस्कमा उही data लेखिन्छ, त्यसैले एउटा बिग्रिए पनि हराउँदैन, तर आधा क्षमता मात्र प्रयोगयोग्य — न्यूनतम दुई डिस्क। RAID 5 ले सबै डिस्कमा फैलिएको parity सहित striping गर्छ, त्यसैले कुनै एउटा बिग्रिए parity बाट पुनर्निर्माण हुन्छ, एउटा डिस्क बराबरको क्षमताको मूल्यमा — न्यूनतम तीन डिस्क।

ne-1jk0yg1 gloss

Exam focus — what is asked from this unit hw-u6.html

English — what it is meant to say

Grandfather–father–son is a media rotation scheme in which daily backups (son) are kept for about a week, weekly backups (father) for about a month, and monthly backups (grandfather) for about a year, with the media reused in that planned cycle. It protects against corruption or an unwanted change that is not noticed immediately: if a single daily backup is overwritten each day, then after a few days every copy held contains the same damage, whereas keeping older generations means an undamaged version still exists.

6.1 What backup and recovery mean hw-u6.html

English — what it is meant to say

Definition — learn this wording A backup is a copy of data kept separately, so that it can be restored if the original is lost, damaged or changed by mistake. Recovery is the process of restoring that data, and returning the system to working order, after a failure. Data is lost in more ways than hardware failure: accidental deletion, overwriting a file, a virus, theft, fire or flood, and a failed update. A backup plan has to survive all of them, which is why keeping the copy in the same building as the original is a weak plan and an off-site copy is part of a serious one. The test of a backup is not whether it ran. It is whether a restore works — a backup that has never been restored from is an assumption, not a safeguard.

नेपाली — the text under review

6.2 Backup methods hw-u6.html

English — what it is meant to say

The three methods compared Full backup — copies everything every time. Slowest to take and uses the most media, but a restore needs only one set, so it is the fastest and safest to recover from. Incremental backup — copies only what has changed since the last backup of any kind. Fastest to take and smallest, but a restore needs the last full backup plus every increment since. If one increment in the chain is missing or damaged, everything after it is lost. Differential backup — copies everything changed since the last full backup. Each day is larger than the last, but a restore needs exactly two sets: the full backup and the most recent differential. The trade is always the same: time and media when you back up, against time and risk when you restore.

नेपाली — the text under review

6.3 Devices, media, scheduling and rotation hw-u6.html

English — what it is meant to say

Definition — learn this wording Backup devices and media: external hard disks (large, fast, cheap per gigabyte); USB flash drives (portable, small capacity); optical discs — CD, DVD, Blu-ray (write once, cheap, slow); magnetic tape (very large capacity, low cost, still used for archives); network attached storage; and cloud storage, which is off-site by nature. Scheduling means deciding when backups run and automating them. Backups that depend on someone remembering do not happen. They are usually scheduled outside working hours, because a backup competes for the disk and the network. Media rotation means reusing a set of media in a planned cycle, so that several generations of backup exist at once. The standard scheme is grandfather–father–son: daily backups (son) are kept for a week, weekly backups (father) for a month, and monthly backups (grandfather) for a year. Rotation is what protects you from a problem you did not notice immediately. If a file was corrupted three weeks ago and every backup has been overwritten since, the only copies you hold are all corrupted too.

नेपाली — the text under review

परिभाषा — यही शब्दमा सम्झनुहोस् ब्याकअप उपकरण र मिडिया: बाहिरी hard disk (ठूलो, छिटो, प्रति GB सस्तो); USB flash drive (बोक्न सजिलो, कम क्षमता); optical disc — CD, DVD, Blu-ray (एक पटक लेखिने, सस्तो, ढिलो); चुम्बकीय टेप (धेरै ठूलो क्षमता, कम लागत, अभिलेखका लागि अझै प्रयोगमा); network attached storage; र cloud storage, जुन स्वभावतः अर्को ठाउँमा हुन्छ। Scheduling भनेको ब्याकअप कहिले चल्ने तय गरेर स्वचालित बनाउनु हो। कसैले सम्झनुपर्ने ब्याकअप हुँदैन। प्रायः कार्यालय समयबाहिर राखिन्छ, किनकि ब्याकअपले डिस्क र नेटवर्क ओगट्छ। Media rotation भनेको मिडियाको समूहलाई योजनाबद्ध चक्रमा पुनः प्रयोग गर्नु, ताकि एकैचोटि ब्याकअपका धेरै पुस्ता रहून्। मानक योजना grandfather–father–son हो: दैनिक ब्याकअप (son) एक हप्ता, साप्ताहिक (father) एक महिना, र मासिक (grandfather) एक वर्ष राखिन्छ। तुरुन्तै थाहा नपाएको समस्याबाट जोगाउने कुरा rotation नै हो। तीन हप्ताअघि फाइल बिग्रेको थियो र त्यसपछि हरेक ब्याकअप ओभरराइट भइसक्यो भने तपाईंसँग भएका सबै प्रतिलिपि पनि बिग्रिएकै हुन्छन्।

6.4 RAID hw-u6.html

English — what it is meant to say

Definition — learn this wording RAID (Redundant Array of Independent Disks) combines several physical disks so the operating system sees them as one drive, in order to gain speed, fault tolerance, or both. RAID 0 — striping. Data is split across the disks, so reads and writes are faster and the full capacity is usable. There is no redundancy: if any one disk fails, all the data is lost. Minimum two disks. RAID 1 — mirroring. The same data is written to both disks. One disk can fail and the system keeps running. Only half the total capacity is usable. Minimum two disks. RAID 5 — striping with parity. Data and parity information are spread across all the disks. Any one disk can fail and its contents are rebuilt from the parity. The capacity of one disk is given up to parity. Minimum three disks.

नेपाली — the text under review

परिभाषा — यही शब्दमा सम्झनुहोस् RAID (Redundant Array of Independent Disks) ले धेरै भौतिक डिस्कलाई जोडेर अपरेटिङ सिस्टमलाई एउटै ड्राइभजस्तो देखाउँछ — गति, खराबी सहनशीलता, वा दुवै पाउन। RAID 0 — striping. Data डिस्कहरूमा बाँडिन्छ, त्यसैले पढ्न–लेख्न छिटो हुन्छ र पूरै क्षमता प्रयोग हुन्छ। कुनै redundancy छैन: एउटा डिस्क बिग्रिए सबै data जान्छ। न्यूनतम दुई डिस्क। RAID 1 — mirroring. उही data दुवै डिस्कमा लेखिन्छ। एउटा बिग्रिए पनि प्रणाली चलिरहन्छ। कुल क्षमताको आधा मात्र प्रयोगयोग्य। न्यूनतम दुई डिस्क। RAID 5 — parity सहितको striping. Data र parity सबै डिस्कमा फैलाइन्छ। कुनै एउटा बिग्रिए त्यसको सामग्री parity बाट पुनर्निर्माण हुन्छ। एउटा डिस्क बराबरको क्षमता parity मा जान्छ। न्यूनतम तीन डिस्क।

6.5 Recovery techniques hw-u6.html

English — what it is meant to say

Match the technique to the failure Restore from backup — the general answer, and the only one that works when data itself has been lost or corrupted. System restore point — rolls the operating system's settings and drivers back to an earlier state. Fixes a bad update or driver; does not recover deleted personal files. Recovery / repair console — repairs a damaged boot sector or system files so the machine can start again. Data recovery software — scans sectors directly to retrieve files whose index entries were deleted. This works precisely because a quick format and a delete do not remove the data itself. Professional recovery from a failed drive — for physical damage such as a head crash, done in a clean room. Expensive, and never guaranteed. Rebuilding a RAID array — replacing a failed disk and letting the array rebuild its contents from the mirror or the parity.

नेपाली — the text under review

खराबी अनुसार उपाय मिलाउनुहोस् ब्याकअपबाट फर्काउने — सामान्य उत्तर, र data नै हराएको वा बिग्रिएको बेला काम लाग्ने एक मात्र उपाय। System restore point — अपरेटिङ सिस्टमका सेटिङ र driver लाई अघिल्लो अवस्थामा फर्काउँछ। खराब अपडेट वा driver मिलाउँछ; मेटिएका व्यक्तिगत फाइल फर्काउँदैन। Recovery / repair console — बिग्रिएको boot sector वा सिस्टम फाइल मर्मत गरेर मेसिन फेरि सुरु हुन दिन्छ। Data recovery सफ्टवेयर — सूची मेटिएका फाइल फर्काउन sector सीधै स्क्यान गर्छ। यो चल्नुको कारण नै quick format र delete ले data आफैँ नहटाउनु हो। बिग्रेको ड्राइभबाट व्यावसायिक रिकभरी — head crash जस्तो भौतिक क्षतिका लागि, clean room मा गरिने। महँगो, र कहिल्यै ग्यारेन्टी नहुने। RAID array पुनर्निर्माण — बिग्रेको डिस्क साटेर array लाई mirror वा parity बाट सामग्री फेरि बनाउन दिने।

ne-2v07fs section label

(page furniture) hw-u6.html

English — what it is meant to say

· निर्णय अभ्यास गर्नुहोस् Which backup or RAID level fits this situation? What you will learn: to choose a method from a described need, which is how this unit is examined — the exam gives you a situation and asks what you would use, not for three definitions. तपाईंले के सिक्नुहुन्छ: वर्णन गरिएको आवश्यकताबाट विधि छान्न — यो युनिट यसै गरी जाँचिन्छ। परीक्षाले तीन परिभाषा होइन, अवस्था दिएर के प्रयोग गर्नुहुन्छ सोध्छ। Why this matters: every option here is correct for something. Marks are lost by choosing one that solves a different problem from the one described — RAID for accidental deletion is the classic.किन महत्त्वपूर्ण छ: यहाँका हरेक विकल्प कुनै न कुनै अवस्थाका लागि ठीक छन्। वर्णन गरिएको भन्दा फरक समस्या समाधान गर्ने विकल्प छानेर अंक गुम्छ — भुलले मेटिएकोमा RAID भन्नु उत्कृष्ट उदाहरण। Example 2 How much space do you actually get? Question: four 2 TB disks are available. What usable capacity does each of RAID 0, RAID 1 and RAID 5 give, and how many disks can fail in each? Step 1 — RAID 0 keeps nothing back. Every disk stores data and none stores a copy or parity, so usable = 4 × 2 = 8 TB. Nothing is protected: 0 disks may fail. Step 2 — RAID 1 stores everything twice. Half the total is a copy, so usable = 8 ÷ 2 = 4 TB. One disk of each mirrored pair may fail. Step 3 — RAID 5 gives up one disk's worth to parity. Usable = (4 − 1) × 2 = 6 TB. Any one disk may fail and be rebuilt from the parity. Answer RAID 0 → 8 TB, no disk may fail · RAID 1 → 4 TB, one per pair · RAID 5 → 6 TB, any one Read the pattern rather than memorising three numbers: capacity and safety trade directly against each other, and RAID 5 exists because it buys most of the capacity of RAID 0 with most of the safety of RAID 1. तीन सङ्ख्या घोक्नुभन्दा ढाँचा पढ्नुहोस्: क्षमता र सुरक्षा सीधै एक–अर्काको सट्टामा जान्छन्, र RAID 5 हुनुको कारण यही हो — यसले RAID 0 को धेरैजसो क्षमता र RAID 1 को धेरैजसो सुरक्षा सँगै दिन्छ। Faded practice

English — what it is meant to say

Sorting once lets every later search be a binary search, which halves the remaining list at each step — about 10 comparisons for 1000 names instead of up to 1000. A stack would make it worse, since you can only reach the top. Shorter names and comments change readability, not running speed.

1.1 What is a Data Structure? u1.html

English — what it is meant to say

Definition — learn this wording A data structure is a particular way of organising, storing and managing data in a computer's memory so that it can be accessed and modified efficiently. Notice what the definition does not say. A data structure is not the data itself. It is the arrangement of the data, together with the rules for putting data in and taking data out.

1.2 Advantages of Data Structures u1.html

English — what it is meant to say

Six advantages Efficiency — the right structure makes searching and sorting far faster. Searching a sorted array by binary search takes about 20 steps for 10,00,000 items; checking one by one takes up to 10,00,000 steps. Reusability — one structure such as a stack can be written once and used in many different programs. Abstraction — the user calls push() without knowing how it works inside. Better memory use — structures like the linked list take memory only when it is actually needed. Easy maintenance — organised data means shorter, clearer code that is easier to correct later. Handles large data — millions of records stay manageable.

1.4 Need of Data Structures u1.html

English — what it is meant to say

Why they are needed Data keeps growing — programs must handle huge amounts of data. Processor speed is limited — a faster CPU cannot rescue a badly arranged pile of data. Search must be fast — searching 1,00,000 unsorted names one by one is far too slow. Many users at once — many requests must reach the data quickly. Memory is limited — data must be stored without waste.

1.5 Classification of Data Structures u1.html

English — what it is meant to say

The two main groups Linear data structure: the elements are arranged in a sequence, one after another. Each element has exactly one element before it and one after it. The whole structure can be traversed completely in a single run. Non-linear data structure: the elements are not in a sequence. One element may be connected to many elements. It cannot be traversed in one straight run. Some books first split data structures into primitive (int, float, char, pointer — supplied by the language) and non-primitive (built by the programmer). Linear and non-linear are the two kinds of non-primitive structures.

नेपाली — the text under review

दुई मुख्य समूह Linear (रेखीय): तत्त्वहरू एउटा पछि अर्को गरी क्रमैसँग राखिन्छन्। प्रत्येकको एउटा अघिल्लो र एउटा पछिल्लो हुन्छ। एकै पटकमा सबै घुम्न सकिन्छ। Non-linear (अरेखीय): तत्त्वहरू क्रममा हुँदैनन्। एउटा तत्त्व धेरैसँग जोडिन सक्छ। सिधा एकै पटकमा सबै घुम्न सकिँदैन। केही किताबले पहिले primitive (int, float, char, pointer — भाषाले नै दिएको) र non-primitive (प्रोग्रामरले बनाएको) भनेर छुट्याउँछन्। Linear र non-linear चाहिँ non-primitive कै दुई प्रकार हुन्।

1.5.1 (a) Array — एरे u1.html

English — what it is meant to say

Array An array is a collection of elements of the same data type, stored in continuous (contiguous) memory locations, and accessed using an index that always starts at 0. Because the memory is continuous and every element is the same size, the computer can calculate the address of any element instantly: address = base + index × size. That is why array access is called direct or random access — reaching a[900] takes exactly as long as reaching a[0].

1.5.1 (b) Linked List — लिंक्ड लिस्ट u1.html

English — what it is meant to say

Linked List A linked list is a collection of elements called nodes, where each node has two parts: the data, and a pointer holding the address of the next node. The nodes are not in continuous memory — they may sit anywhere. The list is held together only by the pointers. A special pointer called head points to the first node, and the last node's pointer holds NULL to mark the end. Because memory is taken one node at a time, the list can grow and shrink while the program is running. This is called a dynamic data structure. Types: singly linked list (one pointer), doubly linked list (pointers to next and previous), circular linked list (last node points back to the first).

1.5.1 (c) Stack — स्ट्याक u1.html

English — what it is meant to say

Stack A stack is a linear data structure in which insertion and deletion take place at only one end, called the top. It follows the LIFO principle — Last In, First Out. The element inserted last is the element removed first. Operations: push() inserts, pop() removes, peek() (or top()) reads the top without removing it, isEmpty() and isFull() check the state. Overflow = pushing into a full stack. Underflow = popping from an empty stack. An empty stack has top = -1. Applications: the browser Back button, Undo in an editor, function calls in memory (the call stack), reversing a string, checking balanced brackets, and converting infix expressions to postfix.

1.5.1 (d) Queue — क्यु u1.html

English — what it is meant to say

Queue A queue is a linear data structure in which insertion takes place at one end (the rear) and deletion takes place at the other end (the front). It follows the FIFO principle — First In, First Out. The element inserted first is the element removed first. Operations: enqueue() inserts at the rear, dequeue() removes from the front, front() reads the first element without removing it. A queue is empty when front > rear. Types: simple queue, circular queue (the rear wraps back to the start to reuse space), priority queue (the most important element leaves first), double-ended queue or deque (insert and delete allowed at both ends). Applications: the printer job queue, CPU scheduling, a call-centre waiting line, and data buffers.

1.5.2 (a) Tree — ट्री u1.html

English — what it is meant to say

Tree A tree is a non-linear data structure that arranges data in a hierarchy of nodes. It has exactly one node at the top called the root, and every other node has exactly one parent. A tree contains no cycles. Terms you must know: Root — the topmost node; the only node with no parent. Parent — a node that has nodes below it. Child — a node directly below another node. Siblings — nodes that share the same parent. Leaf (terminal node) — a node with no children. Level — the root is level 0, its children level 1, and so on. Height / Depth — the number of levels from the root to the deepest leaf. A binary tree is a tree in which every node has at most two children.

1.5.2 (b) Graph — ग्राफ u1.html

English — what it is meant to say

Graph A graph is a non-linear data structure made of a set of vertices (also called nodes) joined by a set of edges (lines). Any vertex may connect to any other vertex. There is no root, no parent–child rule, and cycles are allowed — this is the main difference from a tree. In a directed graph the edges have arrows (one-way). In an undirected graph the edges have no direction (two-way). A weighted graph puts a number on each edge, for example the distance between two cities. Applications: road maps and Google Maps routing, social networks, computer networks.

Array

नेपाली — the text under review

— एरे

Reviewer
ne-qlepsw section label

(page furniture) u1.html

English — what it is meant to say

— एरे Array An array is a collection of elements of the same data type, stored in continuous (contiguous) memory locations, and accessed using an index that always starts at 0. Because the memory is continuous and every element is the same size, the computer can calculate the address of any element instantly: address = base + index × size. That is why array access is called direct or random access — reaching a[900] takes exactly as long as reaching a[0]. एरे एरे भनेको एउटै प्रकारका तत्त्वहरूको संग्रह हो, जुन लगातार मेमोरी मा राखिन्छ र सधैं ० बाट सुरु हुने index ले पुगिन्छ। मेमोरी लगातार भएकाले र हरेक तत्त्वको साइज उही भएकाले कम्प्युटरले जुनसुकै तत्त्वको ठेगाना तुरुन्तै गणना गर्न सक्छ: ठेगाना = base + index × size। त्यसैले एरेको पहुँचलाई direct/random access भनिन्छ — a[900] मा पुग्न पनि a[0] जत्तिकै समय लाग्छ। {{dia:arrayMemory}} Five integers in one continuous block. Index 0 to 4 — never 1 to 5. पाँच पूर्णांक एउटै लगातार ब्लकमा। index ० देखि ४ सम्म — १ देखि ५ होइन। Example 1 Declaring an array and printing it #include <iostream> using namespace std; int main() { int marks[5] = {75, 82, 60, 91, 48}; for (int i = 0; i < 5; i++) { cout << "marks[" << i << "] = " << marks[i] << endl; } return 0; } Output marks[0] = 75 marks[1] = 82 marks[2] = 60 marks[3] = 91 marks[4] = 48 The loop runs while i < 5, so i takes the values 0, 1, 2, 3, 4 — exactly the five valid indexes. लुप i < 5 सम्म चल्छ, त्यसैले i ले ०,१,२,३,४ मान लिन्छ — यीनै पाँच वटा मान्य index हुन्। Common mistake Writing marks[5] to reach the last element. In an array of size 5 the last index is 4. marks[5] is outside the array and gives a garbage value or crashes the program. C++ does not warn you. अन्तिम तत्त्वका लागि marks[5] लेख्नु गलत हो। साइज ५ को एरेमा अन्तिम index ४ हो। marks[5] एरे बाहिर पर्छ र फोहोर मान दिन्छ वा प्रोग्राम क्र्यास हुन्छ। C++ ले चेतावनी दिँदैन। Size 5 means last index 4. The last valid index is always size &minus; 1. साइज ५ भए अन्तिम index ४। अन्तिम मान्य index सधैं साइज &minus; १ हुन्छ। 1.5.1 (b) Linked List

नेपाली — the text under review

— लिंक्ड लिस्ट

Reviewer
ne-jxl0du section label

(page furniture) u1.html

English — what it is meant to say

— लिंक्ड लिस्ट Linked List A linked list is a collection of elements called nodes, where each node has two parts: the data, and a pointer holding the address of the next node. The nodes are not in continuous memory — they may sit anywhere. The list is held together only by the pointers. A special pointer called head points to the first node, and the last node's pointer holds NULL to mark the end. Because memory is taken one node at a time, the list can grow and shrink while the program is running. This is called a dynamic data structure. Types: singly linked list (one pointer), doubly linked list (pointers to next and previous), circular linked list (last node points back to the first). लिंक्ड लिस्ट लिंक्ड लिस्ट भनेको नोड भनिने तत्त्वहरूको संग्रह हो। हरेक नोडका दुई भाग हुन्छन्: डाटा, र अर्को नोडको ठेगाना राख्ने pointer। नोडहरू लगातार मेमोरीमा हुँदैनन् — जहाँसुकै हुन सक्छन्। लिस्टलाई पोइन्टरले मात्र जोडेर राख्छ। head नामक पोइन्टरले पहिलो नोड देखाउँछ, र अन्तिम नोडको पोइन्टरमा NULL हुन्छ जसले अन्त्य जनाउँछ। एक–एक नोड गरी मेमोरी लिने भएकाले लिस्ट प्रोग्राम चल्दै गर्दा घटबढ हुन सक्छ। यसैलाई dynamic डाटा स्ट्रक्चर भनिन्छ। प्रकार: singly (एउटा पोइन्टर), doubly (अघि र पछि दुवैको पोइन्टर), circular (अन्तिम नोडले पहिलो नोड देखाउने)। {{dia:linkedList}} Three nodes at scattered addresses, held together only by pointers. छरिएका ठेगानामा रहेका तीन नोड, पोइन्टरले मात्र जोडिएका। Example 2 What one node looks like in C++ struct Node { int data; // part 1 — the value Node *next; // part 2 — address of the next node }; int main() { Node *head = new Node; // create the first node head->data = 75; head->next = NULL; // NULL means "the list ends here" return 0; } Notice Node *next; — a Node that stores the address of another Node. That single line is what makes the chain possible. Node *next; हेर्नुहोस् — एउटा Node ले अर्को Node को ठेगाना राख्छ। यही एउटा लाइनले शृंखला सम्भव बनाउँछ। Why this difference matters — array vs linked list in action {{dia:arrayVsList}} Inserting into the middle: the array must shift elements, the linked list only re-points two links. This single picture answers most array-vs-list questions. बीचमा थप्दा: एरेले तत्त्वहरू सार्नुपर्छ, लिंक्ड लिस्टले दुई लिंक मात्र फेर्छ। यही एउटा चित्रले array-vs-list का धेरै प्रश्नको जवाफ दिन्छ। 1.5.1 (c) Stack

नेपाली — the text under review

— स्ट्याक

Reviewer
ne-yrmoxz section label

(page furniture) u1.html

English — what it is meant to say

— स्ट्याक Stack A stack is a linear data structure in which insertion and deletion take place at only one end, called the top. It follows the LIFO principle — Last In, First Out. The element inserted last is the element removed first. Operations: push() inserts, pop() removes, peek() (or top()) reads the top without removing it, isEmpty() and isFull() check the state. Overflow = pushing into a full stack. Underflow = popping from an empty stack. An empty stack has top = -1. Applications: the browser Back button, Undo in an editor, function calls in memory (the call stack), reversing a string, checking balanced brackets, and converting infix expressions to postfix. स्ट्याक स्ट्याक त्यस्तो रेखीय डाटा स्ट्रक्चर हो जहाँ राख्ने र झिक्ने काम एउटै छेउ (top) बाट मात्र हुन्छ। यसले LIFO — Last In, First Out नियम मान्छ। अन्तिममा हालेको तत्त्व सबैभन्दा पहिले निस्कन्छ। अपरेसन: push() हाल्ने, pop() झिक्ने, peek() नझिकी हेर्ने, isEmpty() र isFull() अवस्था जाँच्ने। Overflow = भरिएको स्ट्याकमा push। Underflow = खाली स्ट्याकबाट pop। खाली स्ट्याकमा top = -1 हुन्छ। प्रयोग: ब्राउजरको Back बटन, एडिटरको Undo, फङ्सन कलको call stack, स्ट्रिङ उल्टाउने, ब्राकेट मिलेको छ कि छैन जाँच्ने, infix लाई postfix मा बदल्ने। {{dia:stackOps}} Both push and pop use the same end. Only top moves. push र pop दुवै उही छेउ प्रयोग गर्छन्। top मात्र सर्छ। Analogy — a pile of plates You wash plates and stack them one on top of another. The plate you put down last sits on top, so it is the plate you pick up first. The very first plate is at the bottom and leaves last. You cannot pull a plate from the middle without lifting the ones above it. उदाहरण — थाकिएका प्लेट। धोएर एक–अर्कामाथि थुपारेका प्लेटमध्ये अन्तिममा राखेको सबैभन्दा माथि हुन्छ, त्यसैले पहिले त्यही उठाइन्छ। पहिलो प्लेट सबैभन्दा तल हुन्छ र अन्तिममा निस्कन्छ। 1.5.1 (d) Queue

नेपाली — the text under review

— क्यु

Reviewer
ne-ys00hf section label

(page furniture) u1.html

English — what it is meant to say

— क्यु Queue A queue is a linear data structure in which insertion takes place at one end (the rear) and deletion takes place at the other end (the front). It follows the FIFO principle — First In, First Out. The element inserted first is the element removed first. Operations: enqueue() inserts at the rear, dequeue() removes from the front, front() reads the first element without removing it. A queue is empty when front > rear. Types: simple queue, circular queue (the rear wraps back to the start to reuse space), priority queue (the most important element leaves first), double-ended queue or deque (insert and delete allowed at both ends). Applications: the printer job queue, CPU scheduling, a call-centre waiting line, and data buffers. क्यु क्यु त्यस्तो रेखीय डाटा स्ट्रक्चर हो जहाँ एउटा छेउ (rear) बाट राखिन्छ र अर्को छेउ (front) बाट झिकिन्छ। यसले FIFO — First In, First Out नियम मान्छ। पहिले हालेको पहिले निस्कन्छ। अपरेसन: enqueue() पछाडि हाल्ने, dequeue() अगाडिबाट झिक्ने, front() पहिलो तत्त्व नझिकी हेर्ने। front > rear हुँदा क्यु खाली हुन्छ। प्रकार: simple queue, circular queue (rear घुमेर सुरुमै फर्कने), priority queue (महत्त्वपूर्ण तत्त्व पहिले निस्कने), deque (दुवै छेउबाट राख्न–झिक्न मिल्ने)। प्रयोग: प्रिन्टरको job queue, CPU scheduling, कल–सेन्टरको लाइन, डाटा बफर। {{dia:queueOps}} Two different ends: join at the rear, leave from the front. दुई फरक छेउ: पछाडिबाट लाइनमा बस्ने, अगाडिबाट निस्कने। 1.5.2 (a) Tree

नेपाली — the text under review

— ट्री

Reviewer
ne-apyhla section label

(page furniture) u1.html

English — what it is meant to say

— ट्री Tree A tree is a non-linear data structure that arranges data in a hierarchy of nodes. It has exactly one node at the top called the root, and every other node has exactly one parent. A tree contains no cycles. Terms you must know: Root — the topmost node; the only node with no parent. Parent — a node that has nodes below it. Child — a node directly below another node. Siblings — nodes that share the same parent. Leaf (terminal node) — a node with no children. Level — the root is level 0, its children level 1, and so on. Height / Depth — the number of levels from the root to the deepest leaf. A binary tree is a tree in which every node has at most two children. ट्री ट्री त्यस्तो अरेखीय डाटा स्ट्रक्चर हो जसले डाटालाई नोडहरूको तह (hierarchy) मा मिलाउँछ। माथि एउटा मात्र root हुन्छ, र अरू हरेक नोडको एउटा मात्र parent हुन्छ। ट्रीमा चक्र (cycle) हुँदैन। जान्नैपर्ने शब्दहरू: Root — सबैभन्दा माथिको नोड; parent नभएको एक मात्र नोड। Parent — तल नोड भएको नोड। Child — कुनै नोडको ठीक तलको नोड। Siblings — एउटै parent भएका नोडहरू। Leaf — सन्तान नभएको नोड। Level — root level ०, त्यसका सन्तान level १, यसरी नै। Height — root देखि सबैभन्दा तलको leaf सम्मको तह संख्या। Binary tree भनेको हरेक नोडका बढीमा दुई सन्तान हुने ट्री हो। {{dia:tree}} A is the root. D, E and F are leaves. D and E are siblings. A root हो। D, E, F leaf हुन्। D र E siblings हुन्। 1.5.2 (b) Graph

A class keeps marks as a private member and
provides setMarks() and getMarks() to reach it.
English — what it is meant to say

Data and the functions that work on it are wrapped together in one class, and the data is protected from direct access. That wrapping is encapsulation. The private keyword is its usual sign.

नेपाली — the text under review

डाटा र त्यसमा काम गर्ने फङ्सन एउटै क्लासमा बाँधिएका छन्, र डाटा सिधै पहुँचबाट जोगिएको छ। यही बाँधाइ नै encapsulation हो। private शब्द यसको सामान्य सङ्केत हो।

Technical terms left in English: encapsulation private

2.4 Structured vs Object-Oriented Programming u2.html

English — what it is meant to say

Abstraction. Complexity is hidden and only what you need is shown. The test that separates the two: abstraction hides COMPLEXITY, encapsulation hides DATA. A private variable with a getter is encapsulation; a dashboard that shows speed without the mechanism is abstraction. Unit 4 spends a whole section on this pair — it is asked most years.

नेपाली — the text under review

2.1 What is Object Oriented Programming? u2.html

English — what it is meant to say

Definition — learn this wording Object Oriented Programming (OOP) is a programming method that solves a big problem by breaking it into small parts called objects. Each object keeps its own data and the functions that work on that data bound together, so that no other part of the program can access that data directly. The key phrase examiners look for is "binds together data and the functions that operate on that data".

नेपाली — the text under review

परिभाषा — यही शब्द कण्ठ पार्नुहोस् OOP भनेको ठूलो समस्यालाई अब्जेक्ट भनिने साना–साना भागमा बाँडेर समाधान गर्ने प्रोग्रामिङ तरिका हो। हरेक अब्जेक्टले आफ्नो डाटा र त्यही डाटामाथि काम गर्ने फङ्सन लाई सँगै बाँधेर राख्छ, ताकि प्रोग्रामको अरू भागले त्यो डाटा सिधै छुन नसकोस्। परीक्षकले खोज्ने मुख्य वाक्यांश: "डाटा र त्यसमाथि काम गर्ने फङ्सनलाई सँगै बाँध्छ"।

2.5 Tokens and Character Set u2.html

English — what it is meant to say

Token A token is the smallest individual unit of a C++ program that has meaning to the compiler. When the compiler reads your program it first breaks it into tokens. The character set is every character C++ understands: letters A–Z and a–z, digits 0–9, special symbols such as + - * / = < > ( ) { } ; ,, and white space (space, tab, newline).

नेपाली — the text under review

टोकन टोकन भनेको C++ प्रोग्रामको सबैभन्दा सानो अर्थपूर्ण एकाइ हो, जुन कम्पाइलरले बुझ्छ। कम्पाइलरले प्रोग्राम पढ्दा पहिले यसलाई टोकनमा टुक्र्याउँछ। Character set भनेको C++ ले बुझ्ने सबै अक्षर हो: A–Z, a–z, ०–९, विशेष चिन्ह + - * / = ( ) { } ;, र खाली ठाउँ।

2.7 Basic Input and Output u2.html

English — what it is meant to say

cout and cin cout << sends data out to the screen. << is called the insertion operator. cin >> takes data in from the keyboard. >> is called the extraction operator. Both are objects defined in the header file <iostream> and both live inside the namespace std. endl moves the cursor to a new line. Memory trick: the arrows point in the direction the data travels. cout << x — data flows out of x into cout. cin >> x — data flows from cin into x.

नेपाली — the text under review

cout र cin cout << ले डाटा स्क्रिनमा बाहिर पठाउँछ। << लाई insertion operator भनिन्छ। cin >> ले किबोर्डबाट डाटा भित्र लिन्छ। >> लाई extraction operator भनिन्छ। दुवै <iostream> हेडर फाइलमा भएका अब्जेक्ट हुन् र std नेमस्पेस भित्र बस्छन्। endl ले नयाँ लाइनमा लैजान्छ। सम्झने तरिका: तीर जता फर्किएको छ, डाटा त्यतै जान्छ।

Technical terms left in English: cout cin insertion operator extraction iostream> std endl

OverloadingNot supported.Supported — function and operator overloading. Suitable forSmall, simple programs.Large, complex programs. Example languagesC, Pascal, FORTRAN, BASICC++, Java, Python, C#

नेपाली — the text under review

छोटो सार POP मा फङ्सन मुख्य हुन्छ, डाटा प्रायः global हुने भएकाले कम सुरक्षित हुन्छ, र यसले माथिबाट तल (top-down) सोच्छ। OOP मा अब्जेक्ट मुख्य हुन्छ, डाटा private राखेर लुकाइन्छ, र तलबाट माथि (bottom-up) सोच्छ। ठूलो प्रोग्रामका लागि OOP राम्रो। Predict first · पहिले अनुमान गर्नुहोस् A driver uses a steering wheel without knowing how the engine works. Which feature of OOP does that describe? चालकले इन्जिन कसरी चल्छ नजानीकनै स्टेयरिङ चलाउँछन्। यसले OOP को कुन विशेषता जनाउँछ? Encapsulation Abstraction Inheritance Abstraction. Complexity is hidden and only what you need is shown. The test that separates the two: abstraction hides COMPLEXITY, encapsulation hides DATA. A private variable with a getter is encapsulation; a dashboard that shows speed without the mechanism is abstraction. Unit 4 spends a whole section on this pair — it is asked most years. Abstraction। जटिलता लुकाइएको छ र चाहिने कुरा मात्र देखाइएको छ। छुट्याउने जाँच: abstraction ले जटिलता लुकाउँछ, encapsulation ले डाटा। Getter सहितको private चल encapsulation हो; संयन्त्र नदेखाई गति देखाउने ड्यासबोर्ड abstraction हो।

3.1 Class and Object u3.html

English — what it is meant to say

Class A class is a user-defined data type that acts as a blueprint or template. It groups data members (the variables) and member functions (the methods) together into one unit. A class does not take any memory — it is only a design. Memory is allocated only when an object is created from it.

नेपाली — the text under review

क्लास क्लास भनेको प्रयोगकर्ताले बनाएको डाटा टाइप हो, जुन नक्सा (blueprint) जस्तै काम गर्छ। यसले डाटा मेम्बर (भेरिएबल) र मेम्बर फङ्सन (मेथड) लाई एउटै एकाइमा राख्छ। क्लासले मेमोरी लिँदैन — यो डिजाइन मात्र हो। अब्जेक्ट बनेपछि मात्र मेमोरी छुट्याइन्छ।

Technical terms left in English: blueprint

3.1 Class and Object u3.html

English — what it is meant to say

Object An object is a variable of a class — one real copy built from the blueprint. An object does take memory, and each object has its own separate copy of the data members. The act of creating an object from a class is called instantiation.

नेपाली — the text under review

अब्जेक्ट अब्जेक्ट भनेको क्लासको भेरिएबल हो — नक्सा हेरेर बनाइएको वास्तविक प्रति। अब्जेक्टले मेमोरी लिन्छ, र हरेक अब्जेक्टसँग आफ्नै छुट्टै डाटा हुन्छ। क्लासबाट अब्जेक्ट बनाउने कामलाई instantiation भनिन्छ।

3.5 Constructor and Destructor u3.html

English — what it is meant to say

Constructor A constructor is a special member function that is called automatically when an object is created. Its job is to initialise the object's data. Its name is exactly the same as the class name. It has no return type — not even void. It can take parameters and can be overloaded. Three types: Default constructor — takes no arguments. Parameterized constructor — takes arguments to set the starting values. Copy constructor — creates a new object as a copy of an existing one, written Student(Student &s).

नेपाली — the text under review

कन्स्ट्रक्टर कन्स्ट्रक्टर एउटा विशेष मेम्बर फङ्सन हो, जुन अब्जेक्ट बन्ने बित्तिकै आफैं बोलिन्छ। यसको काम डाटालाई सुरुवाती मान दिनु हो। नाम क्लासकै नामसँग ठ्याक्कै मिल्नुपर्छ। return type हुँदैन — void पनि होइन। प्यारामिटर लिन सक्छ र overload पनि हुन सक्छ। तीन प्रकार: Default — कुनै आर्गुमेन्ट नलिने। Parameterized — सुरुको मान तोक्न आर्गुमेन्ट लिने। Copy — भइरहेको अब्जेक्टको प्रतिलिपि बनाउने।

Technical terms left in English: return type void overload Default Parameterized Copy

ne-54r0mx lesson prose

3.5 Constructor and Destructor u3.html

English — what it is meant to say

Destructor A destructor is a special member function that is called automatically when an object is destroyed — that is, when it goes out of scope. Its job is to free the memory the object was using. Its name is the class name with a tilde ~ in front. It has no return type and takes no parameters. It cannot be overloaded — a class has exactly one destructor. Objects are destroyed in the reverse order of their creation.

abstraction-vs-encapsulation questions/grade10-oop-cpp.js

English — what it is meant to say

Abstraction is about DESIGN — deciding what to show. Encapsulation is about IMPLEMENTATION — wrapping the data with the functions that may touch it. A car pedal is abstraction: you press it without knowing the engine. The sealed engine casing is encapsulation. They work together but are not the same, and the exam asks you to tell them apart.

Compile नै हुँदैन। प्रोग्राम चल्नुअघि नै compiler ले अस्वीकार गर्छ — मुख्य कुरा यही हो। Encapsulation चेतावनी वा परम्परा होइन; private शब्दले गलत परिवर्तन लेख्नै नसकिने बनाउँछ। "Getter–setter किन चाहियो?" को उत्तर यही हो: हरेक परिवर्तन withdraw() हुँदै जान्छ, जहाँ ऋणात्मक मौज्दात एकै ठाउँमा रोक्न सकिन्छ।

4.1 Abstraction u4.html

English — what it is meant to say

Definition — learn this wording Abstraction means showing only the essential features of an object to the user and hiding the internal implementation details — that is, hiding how the work is actually done. In C++ abstraction is achieved in two ways: using classes with access specifiers (data and helper functions kept private, only the useful functions made public), and at a higher level using abstract classes.

नेपाली — the text under review

परिभाषा — यही शब्द कण्ठ पार्नुहोस् एब्स्ट्र्याक्सन भनेको प्रयोगकर्तालाई आवश्यक कुरा मात्र देखाउने र भित्री काम कसरी हुन्छ भन्ने लुकाउने हो। C++ मा यो दुई तरिकाले हासिल गरिन्छ: access specifier सहितको क्लास (डाटा र सहायक फङ्सन private, काम लाग्ने फङ्सन मात्र public), र माथिल्लो तहमा abstract class मार्फत।

Technical terms left in English: C++ access specifier private public abstract class

ne-10rhq8 lesson prose

4.1 Abstraction u4.html

English — what it is meant to say

Advantages of abstraction Reduces complexity — the user sees a small, simple interface instead of thousands of lines. Increases security — internal data and helper functions cannot be misused. Easy to change later — the hidden code can be rewritten without breaking any program that uses it. Improves reusability — the same class can be used in many programs. Avoids code duplication and makes maintenance easier.

Abstract class and pure virtual function u4.html

English — what it is meant to say

The higher level of abstraction A pure virtual function is a virtual function with no body, written by putting = 0 after it. It is a promise that says "every child class must provide this function". A class that contains at least one pure virtual function is called an abstract class. You cannot create an object of an abstract class — it exists only to be inherited.

नेपाली — the text under review

माथिल्लो तहको abstraction Pure virtual function भनेको शरीर नभएको virtual फङ्सन हो, जसमा पछाडि = 0 लेखिन्छ। यसले "हरेक सन्तान क्लासले यो फङ्सन दिनैपर्छ" भन्ने वाचा गर्छ। कम्तीमा एउटा pure virtual function भएको क्लासलाई abstract class भनिन्छ। यसको अब्जेक्ट बनाउन मिल्दैन — यो इनहेरिट गर्नकै लागि मात्र हुन्छ।

4.4 Encapsulation u4.html

English — what it is meant to say

Definition — learn this wording Encapsulation means binding data members and member functions together into a single unit (the class), and hiding the data from direct outside access by declaring it private. Outside code must then go through public functions — usually called setter and getter functions — to change or read that data. For this reason encapsulation is also called data hiding.

नेपाली — the text under review

परिभाषा — यही शब्द कण्ठ पार्नुहोस् इनक्याप्सुलेसन भनेको डाटा मेम्बर र मेम्बर फङ्सनलाई एउटै एकाइ (क्लास) मा बाँध्ने र डाटालाई private बनाएर बाहिरबाट सिधै छुन नदिने हो। त्यसपछि बाहिरको कोडले डाटा बदल्न वा पढ्न public फङ्सन (setter/getter) प्रयोग गर्नै पर्छ। त्यसैले यसलाई data hiding पनि भनिन्छ।

Technical terms left in English: private public setter getter data hiding

ne-v8cbgk lesson prose

4.4 Encapsulation u4.html

English — what it is meant to say

Advantages of encapsulation Data security — data cannot be changed accidentally or wrongly from outside. Full control — the setter can validate the value before storing it. Read-only or write-only access — provide only a getter, or only a setter, as needed. Easier maintenance and testing — the class can be changed inside without affecting other code. Achieves data hiding, which is one of the main goals of OOP.

नेपाली — the text under review

इनक्याप्सुलेसनका फाइदा डाटा सुरक्षा — बाहिरबाट गल्तीले डाटा बदलिन सक्दैन। पूर्ण नियन्त्रण — setter ले मान राख्नु अघि जाँच्न सक्छ। पढ्ने मात्र वा लेख्ने मात्र पहुँच दिन सकिन्छ। मर्मत र परीक्षण सजिलो — भित्र बदल्दा अरू कोडमा असर पर्दैन। Data hiding हासिल हुन्छ, जुन OOP कै मुख्य लक्ष्य हो।

Technical terms left in English: setter Data hiding OOP

Reusability is the point: common behaviour lives in one tested place and every child gets it. That also makes a program easier to extend — a new derived class needs only what is different. private-base-access questions/grade10-oop-cpp.js

English — what it is meant to say

private means "this class only", and inheriting does not loosen it — x is inherited by B but B is not allowed to touch it. protected is the specifier that exists for exactly this situation: visible to derived classes, still hidden from the outside world.
