5.1 What is Inheritance? u5.html

English — what it is meant to say

Definition — learn this wording Inheritance is the process by which one class acquires (gets) the properties and member functions of another class. The class that gives its features is the base class (also called parent or super class). The class that receives them is the derived class (also called child or sub class). The main purpose is reusability of code — common code is written once in the base class and reused by every derived class. Inheritance represents an "IS-A" relationship: a Dog IS-A Animal, a Circle IS-A Shape. If you cannot say "IS-A", inheritance is probably the wrong tool.

नेपाली — the text under review

परिभाषा — यही शब्द कण्ठ पार्नुहोस् इनहेरिटेन्स भनेको एउटा क्लासले अर्को क्लासका गुण र मेम्बर फङ्सन प्राप्त गर्ने प्रक्रिया हो। गुण दिने क्लास base class (बाबु/parent) हो। गुण पाउने क्लास derived class (छोरा/child) हो। मुख्य उद्देश्य कोडको पुनः प्रयोग हो — साझा कोड एक पटक base मा लेख्ने र सबै derived क्लासमा चलाउने। इनहेरिटेन्सले "IS-A" सम्बन्ध जनाउँछ: Dog एक प्रकारको Animal हो, Circle एक प्रकारको Shape हो।

Technical terms left in English: base class parent derived child IS-A Dog Animal Circle Shape

Reviewer
ne-z7xj47 lesson prose

5.1 What is Inheritance? u5.html

English — what it is meant to say

Advantages of inheritance Reusability — common code is written once and reused by every child class. Saves time and reduces code size — no duplication. Easy to extend — new features go in a derived class without touching the tested base class. Supports polymorphism — function overriding is impossible without inheritance. Better structure — the parent–child relationship models the real world clearly. Easier maintenance — fixing a bug in the base class fixes it for every derived class at once.

नेपाली — the text under review

इनहेरिटेन्सका फाइदा पुनः प्रयोग — साझा कोड एक पटक लेखेर सबै सन्तान क्लासमा चलाइन्छ। समय र कोड बचत — दोहोरो लेख्नु पर्दैन। सजिलो विस्तार — परीक्षण भइसकेको base नछोई derived मा नयाँ सुविधा थपिन्छ। Polymorphism सम्भव बनाउँछ — inheritance बिना overriding हुँदैन। राम्रो संरचना — बाबु–छोराको सम्बन्धले वास्तविक संसार प्रस्ट देखाउँछ। सजिलो मर्मत — base मा गल्ती सुधार्दा सबै derived क्लासमा एकैचोटि सुधार हुन्छ।

The diamond problem and virtual base class u5.html

English — what it is meant to say

The problem In hybrid inheritance, suppose B and C both inherit from A, and D inherits from both B and C. D then receives two copies of everything in A — one through B and one through C. When you write d.show() the compiler cannot decide which copy to use, and reports an ambiguity error. Because the diagram is diamond-shaped, this is called the diamond problem.

नेपाली — the text under review

ne-1fgyo10 section label

(page furniture) u5.html

English — what it is meant to say

· निर्णय अभ्यास गर्नुहोस् Name the type of inheritance from the code What you will learn: to tell the five types apart quickly — the paper gives you code or a diagram and asks for the name, and multilevel versus multiple is where the mark is lost. तपाईंले के सिक्नुहुन्छ: पाँच प्रकार छिटो छुट्याउन — परीक्षामा कोड वा चित्र दिएर नाम सोधिन्छ, र अंक multilevel र multiple बीचमै गुम्छ। How to use this Two counts settle almost every case. How many parents does any one class have? More than one → multiple. How many children does one base have? More than one → hierarchical. A chain where each class has one parent but there is more than one level → multilevel. Case 5 mixes two shapes on purpose, because a real question sometimes does. Read the reason for how to answer when a diagram is not purely one type. दुई गणनाले प्रायः सबै केस मिलाउँछन्। कुनै एउटा क्लासका कति बाबु छन्? एकभन्दा बढी → multiple। एउटा base का कति छोरा छन्? एकभन्दा बढी → hierarchical। हरेकको एउटै बाबु तर धेरै तह भएको शृंखला → multilevel। केस ५ मा जानाजान दुई आकार मिसिएका छन्। Constructor and destructor order — asked very often {{dia:ctorOrder}} One object, three constructors. Base first going down, derived first coming back up. एउटा अब्जेक्ट, तीन कन्स्ट्रक्टर। बन्दा base पहिले, नष्ट हुँदा derived पहिले। The rule in one line When a derived object is created, the base class constructor runs FIRST, then the derived constructor. Destructors run in the exact reverse: derived destructor first, then base destructor. derived अब्जेक्ट बन्दा पहिले base को कन्स्ट्रक्टर चल्छ, अनि derived को। डिस्ट्रक्टर ठ्याक्कै उल्टो — पहिले derived, अनि base। Example 4 Proving the order — predict this output before you read it #include <iostream> using namespace std; class A { public: A() { cout << "A constructor" << endl; } ~A() { cout << "A destructor" << endl; } }; class B : public A { public: B() { cout << "B constructor" << endl; } ~B() { cout << "B destructor" << endl; } }; int main() { B obj; // only ONE object is created return 0; } This is the promise in the title — so keep it. One object, four lines of output. Write all four down in order before opening this. The destructor order is not the constructor order, and that is the exam question. शीर्षकमा गरिएको वाचा यही हो — त्यसैले पूरा गर्नुहोस्। एउटै object, चार लाइन output। खोल्नुअघि चारै लाइन क्रम मिलाएर लेख्नुहोस्। destructor को क्रम constructor को क्रम होइन, र परीक्षाको प्रश्न त्यही हो। Output A constructor B constructor B destructor A destructor Four lines from one object. The base is built first (you cannot build the first floor before the ground floor) and destroyed last. एउटै अब्जेक्टबाट चार लाइन। base पहिले बन्छ (भुइँतला नबनाई पहिलो तला बन्दैन) र अन्तिममा भत्किन्छ। Practise it — the help comes away

public:
    void find(int s);

English — what it is meant to say

One class, one name, two different parameter lists — one argument against two. There is no inheritance here at all, and the compiler can pick the right function from the call itself, so this is compile-time polymorphism.

6.5 Function Overriding — run-time u6.html

English — what it is meant to say

Function overriding Function overriding means the derived class defines a function with exactly the same name, the same return type and the same parameters as a function already present in its base class. The derived version replaces the base version for objects of the derived class. Overriding requires inheritance — it is impossible without a base and a derived class. If the base function is marked virtual and you call it through a base class pointer, C++ calls the derived version at run time. That is run-time polymorphism. Without virtual, the base version is called instead.

नेपाली — the text under review

फङ्सन ओभरराइडिङ Function overriding भनेको derived क्लासमा base क्लासकै फङ्सन जस्तै उही नाम, उही return type र उही प्यारामिटर भएको फङ्सन लेख्नु हो। derived अब्जेक्टका लागि derived कै संस्करणले base को संस्करणलाई प्रतिस्थापन गर्छ। Overriding का लागि inheritance अनिवार्य छ। base फङ्सनमा virtual लेखिएको छ र base पोइन्टर बाट बोलाइयो भने C++ ले चल्दै गर्दा derived संस्करण बोलाउँछ — यही run-time polymorphism हो। virtual नलेखे base कै संस्करण चल्छ।

छोटो सार Overloading = उही क्लासमा उही नाम तर फरक प्यारामिटर; inheritance चाहिँदैन; compile-time। Overriding = derived क्लासमा उही नाम र उही प्यारामिटर; inheritance चाहिन्छ; virtual राखे run-time। Practise the judgement · निर्णय अभ्यास गर्नुहोस् Read the code and name it: overloading, overriding, or neither? What you will learn: to apply the table above to code you have not seen. The paper prints a class and asks which kind of polymorphism it is — and two of these six cases are neither, which is where the mark goes. तपाईंले के सिक्नुहुन्छ: माथिको तालिकालाई नदेखेको कोडमा लागू गर्न। परीक्षामा क्लास छापेर कुन किसिमको polymorphism हो सोधिन्छ — र यी छ केसमध्ये दुई "दुवै होइन" हुन्, अंक त्यहीँ जान्छ। How to use this Work the three checks in the order the lead gives them. One class or two? One class means it can only be overloading. Same parameters or different? Different means overloading; the same means you are looking at a redefinition. Only then look for virtual. Cases 3 and 4 are the two that are neither, and they fail for completely different reasons: case 3 compiles and quietly runs the wrong function, case 4 does not compile at all. Read both reasons — a question that shows you code without virtual is testing case 3 on purpose. लिडमा दिइएका तीन जाँच क्रमैसँग गर्नुहोस्। एक क्लास कि दुई? एउटै क्लास भए overloading मात्र हुन सक्छ। प्यारामिटर उही कि फरक? फरक भए overloading; उही भए पुनर्परिभाषा हेर्दै छ। त्यसपछि मात्र virtual खोज्नुहोस्। केस ३ र ४ दुवै होइन, तर कारण बेग्लै छ: केस ३ compile हुन्छ र चुपचाप गलत फङ्सन चलाउँछ, केस ४ compile नै हुँदैन।

For example + normally adds numbers. By overloading it, you can make c1 + c2 add two Complex number objects. The syntax uses the keyword operator followed by the symbol. अपरेटर ओभरलोडिङ Operator overloading भनेको भइरहेको C++ अपरेटरलाई थप अर्थ दिनु हो, ताकि यो तपाईंकै क्लासका अब्जेक्टसँग पनि काम गरोस्। जस्तै + ले सामान्यतया संख्या जोड्छ। ओभरलोड गरेपछि c1 + c2 ले दुई Complex अब्जेक्ट जोड्न सक्छ। Syntax मा operator कीवर्ड पछि चिन्ह लेखिन्छ। Example 2 Overloading the + operator #include <iostream> using namespace std; class Complex { int real, imag; public: Complex(int r = 0, int i = 0) { real = r; imag = i; } Complex operator + (Complex c) { // overloading + Complex temp; temp.real = real + c.real; temp.imag = imag + c.imag; return temp; } void show() { cout << real << " + " << imag << "i" << endl; } }; int main() { Complex c1(3, 2), c2(1, 7); Complex c3 = c1 + c2; // + now works on objects c3.show(); return 0; } Output 4 + 9i Note that + still adds ordinary numbers exactly as before. Overloading adds a meaning; it never removes the original one. + ले सामान्य संख्या पहिले जस्तै जोड्छ। ओभरलोडिङले अर्थ थप्छ, पुरानो अर्थ हटाउँदैन। 6.5 Function Overriding — run-time Function overriding Function overriding means the derived class defines a function with exactly the same name, the same return type and the same parameters as a function already present in its base class. The derived version replaces the base version for objects of the derived class. Overriding requires inheritance — it is impossible without a base and a derived class. If the base function is marked virtual and you call it through a base class pointer, C++ calls the derived version at run time. That is run-time polymorphism. Without virtual, the base version is called instead. फङ्सन ओभरराइडिङ Function overriding भनेको derived क्लासमा base क्लासकै फङ्सन जस्तै उही नाम, उही return type र उही प्यारामिटर भएको फङ्सन लेख्नु हो। derived अब्जेक्टका लागि derived कै संस्करणले base को संस्करणलाई प्रतिस्थापन गर्छ। Overriding का लागि inheritance अनिवार्य छ। base फङ्सनमा virtual लेखिएको छ र base पोइन्टर बाट बोलाइयो भने C++ ले चल्दै गर्दा derived संस्करण बोलाउँछ — यही run-time polymorphism हो। virtual नलेखे base कै संस्करण चल्छ। {{dia:dispatch}} The same pointer and the same call give two different answers, because virtual makes C++ look at the real object. उही पोइन्टर, उही कल — तर दुई फरक जवाफ, किनकि virtual ले C++ लाई वास्तविक अब्जेक्ट हेर्न लगाउँछ। Example 3 With and without virtual — the exam's favourite trick class Base { public: void show() { cout << "Base show" << endl; } // NOT virtual }; class Derived : public Base { public: void show() { cout << "Derived show" << endl; } }; int main() { Base *p; Derived d; p = &d; p->show(); // a Base pointer, holding a Derived object return 0; } A Base pointer is holding a Derived object, and show() is not virtual. Commit to one line of output. Most people answer with the type of the object; without virtual, C++ answers with the type of the pointer. Base pointer ले Derived object समातेको छ, र show() virtual छैन। एउटै लाइन output भन्नुहोस्। धेरैले object को प्रकार भन्छन्; virtual नभए C++ ले pointer को प्रकार भन्छ। Output without virtual Base show Now add one word — virtual void show() in Base — and the very same program prints Derived show instead. One keyword changes the whole output. That is exactly what the examiner is testing. अब Base मा एउटा शब्द थप्नुहोस् — virtual void show() — र उही प्रोग्रामले Derived show छाप्छ। एउटा कीवर्डले पूरै आउटपुट फेर्छ। परीक्षकले जाँच्ने ठ्याक्कै यही हो। Common mistake Thinking overriding works through the object as well as the pointer. If you write Derived d; d.show(); the derived version runs whether or not the function is virtual — because the object's type is known exactly. virtual only matters when you call through a base class pointer or reference. Derived d; d.show(); लेख्दा virtual भए पनि नभए पनि derived कै संस्करण चल्छ — किनकि अब्जेक्टको प्रकार ठ्याक्कै थाहा हुन्छ। virtual को महत्त्व base पोइन्टर बाट बोलाउँदा मात्र देखिन्छ। virtual matters only through a pointer or reference. Through the object, the type is already known. virtual ले pointer वा reference मार्फत मात्र फरक पार्छ। वस्तु मार्फत त प्रकार पहिले नै थाहा हुन्छ। ▶ Experiment — Which function actually runs? Overloading — the compiler counts the arguments and picks the matching version before the program ever runs. Compile-time. Virtual override — the computer looks at the object the pointer actually points to, while the program is running. Run-time. Same call, different output. Overloading: कम्पाइलरले आर्गुमेन्ट गनेर प्रोग्राम चल्नु अघि नै छान्छ — compile-time। Virtual override: पोइन्टरले देखाएको वास्तविक अब्जेक्ट हेरेर चल्दै गर्दा छान्छ — run-time। उही कल, फरक आउटपुट। Overloading vs Overriding — the key table BasisFunction OverloadingFunction Overriding MeaningSame function name with different parameters in the same class.Same function name with the same parameters, redefined in a derived class. InheritanceNot required.Required — there must be a base and a derived class. ParametersMust be different — in number, type or order.Must be exactly the same. Return typeMay be same or different (return type alone is not enough).Must be the same. BindingEarly / static binding.Late / dynamic binding when virtual is used. TypeCompile-time polymorphism.Run-time polymorphism. virtual keywordNot used.virtual is used in the base class. PurposeTo give one name to several similar jobs.To give the child a different version of the parent's function. छोटो सार Overloading = उही क्लासमा उही नाम तर फरक प्यारामिटर; inheritance चाहिँदैन; compile-time। Overriding = derived क्लासमा उही नाम र उही प्यारामिटर; inheritance चाहिन्छ; virtual राखे run-time। Practise the judgement

Reviewer
ne-107css8 section label

(page furniture) u6.html

English — what it is meant to say

· परीक्षा जोड Overloading versus overriding, and compile-time versus run-time, are the highest-frequency questions in the whole subject. Overloading र Overriding, अनि Compile-time र Run-time — यी पूरै विषयकै सबैभन्दा बढी सोधिने प्रश्न हुन्। Q1 · Define polymorphism. Explain its types with examples. [6 marks] Show the answer Polymorphism comes from the Greek words poly (many) and morph (forms), so it means many forms. In C++ it is the ability of the same function name or operator to behave differently in different situations. Compile-time (static) polymorphism — the compiler decides which function to call while compiling, by checking the arguments. It is achieved by function overloading and operator overloading. Example: three area() functions with different parameters. Run-time (dynamic) polymorphism — the decision is made while the program runs, based on the object the base pointer points to. It is achieved by function overriding with virtual functions. Example: Base *p = &derivedObj; p->show(); परिभाषा + दुवै प्रकार + एक–एक उदाहरण। चित्र (रूख) कोरे झन् राम्रो। Q2 · Differentiate between function overloading and function overriding. [5 marks] Show the answer Write a table with at least five rows: meaning (same class, different parameters vs derived class, same parameters); inheritance (not required vs required); parameters (must differ vs must be identical); binding (early/static vs late/dynamic); type (compile-time vs run-time); and the virtual keyword (not used vs used in the base class). कम्तीमा पाँच हरफको तालिका लेख्नुहोस्। Q3 · What is a virtual function? Why is it needed? [3 marks] Show the answer A virtual function is a member function declared in the base class using the keyword virtual and redefined (overridden) in a derived class. It is needed so that when the function is called through a base class pointer, C++ decides at run time which version to run by looking at the actual object being pointed to, instead of the pointer's type. Without virtual the base class version would always be called, and run-time polymorphism would be impossible. परिभाषा + किन चाहिन्छ (base पोइन्टरबाट derived संस्करण चलाउन) — दुवै लेख्नुहोस्। Q4 · Write a program to demonstrate run-time polymorphism. [5 marks] Show the answer Write a base class Shape with virtual void draw(), two derived classes Circle and Square that each override draw(), and a main() that declares Shape *p; then points it first at a Circle object and then at a Square object, calling p->draw(); each time. The output will be "Drawing a Circle" then "Drawing a Square" — the same call giving two different results. That is the full program traced step by step in the Trace a Program section. 1.2 Characteristics of a computer cf-u1.html

English — what it is meant to say

GIGO — the one that costs marks. "Accuracy" means the machine does not make arithmetic mistakes. It does not mean the answer is right. If you type a student's marks as 850 instead of 85, the computer will average 850 perfectly and hand you a wrong result. Garbage In, Garbage Out. Accuracy is a property of the machine; correctness is a property of the data you gave it.

English — what it is meant to say

The curriculum adds two things worth knowing in advance. The practical examination is conducted in the presence of internal and external supervisors, and it assesses both the product and your skill in using equipment — so being able to explain your chart matters as much as the chart. 1.1 What a computer is cf-u1.html

English — what it is meant to say

The definition, and why it is worded that way A computer is an electronic device that accepts data, processes it according to a set of stored instructions, produces information as output, and can store both for later use. Every part of that sentence is doing work. Electronic rules out an abacus. Stored instructions is the important one: a calculator also processes data, but you must press each key. A computer holds the whole list of steps — the program — inside itself and runs it without being told again at every step. The name is misleading. "Computer" means "one who computes", and calculation is only one of the things it does. It also stores, sorts, searches, compares, draws and communicates. Judge a machine by the four stages below, not by its name or its size.

1.2 Characteristics of a computer cf-u1.html

English — what it is meant to say

What a computer is good at Speed — it works in millionths and billionths of a second. A task that would take a clerk a week can finish while you wait. Accuracy — it does not make mistakes in its own arithmetic. Diligence — it does not get bored or tired. The ten-thousandth calculation is done exactly as carefully as the first. Versatility — the same machine prints a bill, plays a song and checks spelling, because changing the program changes the job. Storage — it keeps very large amounts of data and finds any part of it again. Automation — once started, it carries out a whole job without a person at each step. Reliability — it gives the same answer to the same question every time.

1.3 Modern applications of the computer cf-u1.html

English — what it is meant to say

Where computers are actually used in Nepal Education — school records and results, online classes, and the material you are reading now. Banking and money — accounts, ATMs, mobile banking, and the remittance that reaches a village from abroad in minutes rather than weeks. Government — citizenship and land records, the national ID, online passport applications, and tax filing. Health — patient records at a hospital or health post, laboratory machines, and telemedicine that lets a doctor in Kathmandu advise a health worker in a hill district. Communication — email, messaging and video calls. Transport and tourism — online bus and flight booking, and hotel systems. Weather and disaster warning — forecasting the monsoon and giving flood warning downstream, which in Nepal is a use that saves lives. Agriculture — market prices, weather advice and soil records reaching farmers by phone.

ne-h7azoz lesson prose added in Phase 9

1.4 Classification of computers cf-u1.html

English — what it is meant to say

Five questions, not one list Computers are classified on five different bases, and this is where the unit's marks usually are. The mistake to avoid is treating them as one long list. They are five separate questions, and every computer has an answer to all five at once. By size — supercomputer, mainframe, minicomputer, microcomputer. This asks how much work the machine can do at once. By data handling — analog, digital, hybrid. This asks what kind of signal it works with. Analog measures something that changes smoothly, like a voltage. Digital counts in 0s and 1s. Hybrid does both: a fuel pump measures flowing petrol and prints a digital bill. By purpose — general purpose (you can load new programs onto it) or special purpose (built for one job, like the computer in a washing machine). By model — the physical form: desktop, laptop, palmtop and similar. By brand — IBM PC, IBM compatible, Apple.

नेपाली — the text under review

पाँच प्रश्न, एउटै सूची होइन कम्प्युटरको वर्गीकरण पाँच फरक आधार मा हुन्छ, र यस युनिटका अंक प्रायः यहीँ हुन्छन्। बच्नुपर्ने गल्ती — यिनलाई एउटै लामो सूची ठान्नु। यी पाँच छुट्टाछुट्टै प्रश्न हुन्, र हरेक कम्प्युटरसँग पाँचैको उत्तर एकैचोटि हुन्छ। आकार अनुसार — supercomputer, mainframe, minicomputer, microcomputer। यसले मेसिनले एकैपटक कति काम गर्न सक्छ सोध्छ। डाटा ह्यान्डलिङ अनुसार — analog, digital, hybrid। यसले कस्तो सङ्केतसँग काम गर्छ सोध्छ। Analog ले बिस्तारै बदलिने कुरा नाप्छ, जस्तै भोल्टेज। Digital ले ० र १ मा गन्छ। Hybrid ले दुवै गर्छ: पेट्रोल पम्पले बग्ने पेट्रोल नाप्छ र digital बिल छाप्छ। प्रयोजन अनुसार — general purpose (नयाँ प्रोग्राम हाल्न मिल्ने) वा special purpose (एउटै कामका लागि बनेको, जस्तै वासिङ मेसिनभित्रको कम्प्युटर)। मोडेल अनुसार — भौतिक आकार: desktop, laptop, palmtop र यस्तै। ब्रान्ड अनुसार — IBM PC, IBM compatible, Apple।

Practical work — this unit's other 10 hours cf-u1.html

English — what it is meant to say

Why this section exists This unit is 18 hours, not 8. The 8 hours above are theory; the curriculum gives this unit 10 more hours of practical work, and lists six activities for them. Those activities are worth real marks. Of the 50 internal marks for this subject, 18 are practical work (15 for doing it, 3 for keeping records) and 12 are project work (10 for doing it, 2 for records). A further 5 are a viva in which you explain your own practical and project work. This website cannot do any of them for you. They are chart paper, presentations and a speech to your class. What it can do is tell you exactly what is required, what you need, and what to keep so that the marks are there when they are counted.

यो खण्ड किन छ यो युनिट ८ होइन, १८ घण्टाको हो। माथिका ८ घण्टा सैद्धान्तिक हुन्; पाठ्यक्रमले यस युनिटलाई १० घण्टा प्रयोगात्मक काम दिएको छ, र त्यसका लागि छ वटा क्रियाकलाप तोकेको छ। ती क्रियाकलापका साँच्चिकै अंक छन्। यस विषयका ५० आन्तरिक अंकमध्ये १८ अंक प्रयोगात्मक काम (गर्नेको १५, अभिलेखको ३) र १२ अंक प्रोजेक्ट काम (गर्नेको १०, अभिलेखको २) हुन्। थप ५ अंक भाइभाका, जहाँ तपाईंले आफ्नै प्रयोगात्मक र प्रोजेक्ट काम बुझाउनुपर्छ। यी काम यो वेबसाइटले तपाईंका लागि गरिदिन सक्दैन। यी चार्ट पेपर, प्रस्तुतीकरण र कक्षामा बोल्ने काम हुन्। यसले गर्न सक्ने कुरा — के चाहिन्छ, के गर्नुपर्छ र के राख्नुपर्छ ठ्याक्कै बताउने, ताकि अंक गणना हुँदा ती तपाईंसँग होऊन्।
